+        raise ValueError(f"fit placement authority is invalid for {job_id}")
+    recorded_placement = actor_phase.get("placement_authorization")
+    if placement["authority"] == "frozen_panel_initial_placement":
+        if recorded_placement not in (None, placement):
+            raise ValueError(f"initial fit placement receipt differs for {job_id}")
+    elif recorded_placement != placement:
+        raise ValueError(f"moved fit placement lacks exact sealed launch evidence for {job_id}")
+
+    export_path = recovery / "receipts" / f"{job_id}.export.json"
+    exported = read_json(export_path)
+    output = recovery / "exports" / job_id
+    receipt_path = output / "export_receipt.json"
+    command_path = output / "export_command.json"
+    resource_path = output / "export_cell_resource_receipt.json"
+    log_path = recovery / "logs" / f"{job_id}.export.log"
+    receipt = read_json(receipt_path)
+    if (
+        exported.get("schema") != "tabdata-r01-export-recovery.v2"
+        or exported.get("status") != "exported_fixed_epoch5_no_refit"
+        or exported.get("job_id") != job_id
+        or exported.get("old_fit_outputs_modified") is not False
+        or exported.get("fit_recovery_receipt_sha256") != sha256_file(fit_path)
+        or exported.get("export_receipt_path") != str(receipt_path)
+        or exported.get("export_receipt_sha256") != sha256_file(receipt_path)
+        or exported.get("export_command_sha256") != sha256_file(command_path)
+        or exported.get("export_resource_sha256") != sha256_file(resource_path)
+        or exported.get("actor_log_sha256") != sha256_file(log_path)
+        or receipt.get("status") != "completed_fixed_epoch5_feature_only_fp32"
+        or receipt.get("run_name") != job_id
+        or receipt.get("fold") != job["fold"]
+        or receipt.get("seed") != job["seed"]
+        or receipt.get("epoch") != 5
+        or receipt.get("feature_only") is not True
+        or receipt.get("inference_precision") != "fp32"
+        or receipt.get("target_reads_during_export") is not False
+        or receipt.get("checkpoint_sha256") != identity.get("fixed_file_sha256")
+        or exported.get("checkpoint_sha256") != identity.get("fixed_file_sha256")
+        or receipt.get("prediction_sha256") != exported.get("prediction_sha256")
+        or receipt.get("sidecar_sha256") != exported.get("sidecar_sha256")
+    ):
+        raise ValueError(f"fixed-endpoint export receipt chain is invalid for {job_id}")
+    resource = read_json(resource_path)
+    if (
+        resource.get("schema") != "tabdata-b300-process-envelope.v1"
+        or resource.get("status") != "actor_returned"
+        or resource.get("script") != "export_cell.py"
+        or resource.get("visible_devices") != exported.get("visible_gpu_uuid")
+        or "B300" not in str(resource.get("gpu", ""))
+        or resource.get("allocator_budget_bytes") != 6 * 1024**3
+        or resource.get("torch_threads") != 2
+        or type(resource.get("cuda_peak_allocated_bytes")) is not int
+        or type(resource.get("cuda_peak_reserved_bytes")) is not int
+        or not 0 <= resource["cuda_peak_allocated_bytes"] <= 6 * 1024**3
+        or not 0 <= resource["cuda_peak_reserved_bytes"] <= 6 * 1024**3
+    ):
+        raise ValueError(f"export resource receipt is invalid for {job_id}")
+    prediction_path = output / "cache" / f"pred_{job_id}_valid.npy"
+    sidecar_path = output / "cache" / f"pred_{job_id}_valid.json"
+    if sha256_file(prediction_path) != receipt.get("prediction_sha256") or sha256_file(
+        sidecar_path
+    ) != receipt.get("sidecar_sha256"):
+        raise ValueError(f"exported prediction or sidecar bytes changed for {job_id}")
+    return {
+        "job": job,
+        "fit": fit,
+        "fit_path": fit_path,
+        "fit_sha256": sha256_file(fit_path),
+        "identity": identity,
+        "placement_authorization": placement,
+        "export": exported,
+        "export_path": export_path,
+        "export_sha256": sha256_file(export_path),
+        "export_receipt": receipt,
+        "output": output,
+        "prediction_path": prediction_path,
+        "sidecar_path": sidecar_path,
+    }

+def _flag(argv: list[str], flag: str) -> str:
+    """Return one unique value from a stored grader argv."""
+    positions = [index for index, value in enumerate(argv[:-1]) if value == flag]
+    if len(positions) != 1:
+        raise ValueError(f"stored grade command must contain exactly one {flag}")
+    return argv[positions[0] + 1]
+
+
+def _finite_wp(value: object, label: str) -> float:
+    """Require one finite official weighted-Pearson score."""
+    if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, (int, float)) or not math.isfinite(value):
+        raise ValueError(f"official {label} WP is missing or nonfinite")
+    return float(value)
+
+
+def _verify_grade_bindings(
+    grade: dict[str, Any],
+    fold: int,
+    split_sha: str,
+    groups: list[int],
+    wide_job: dict[str, Any],
+    deep_job: dict[str, Any],
+    wide_binding: dict[str, Any],
+    deep_binding: dict[str, Any],
+) -> tuple[float, float]:
+    """Require official score endpoints to match both fixed checkpoints and predictions."""
+    if (
+        grade.get("schema") != "priority25.endpoint_grade.v1"
+        or grade.get("metric_id") != METRIC_ID
+        or grade.get("fold") != fold
+        or grade.get("split_manifest_sha256") != split_sha
+        or grade.get("evaluation_row_groups") != groups
+        or grade.get("endpoint", {}).get("run") != deep_job["id"]
+        or grade.get("endpoint", {}).get("epoch") != 5
+        or grade.get("reference", {}).get("run") != wide_job["id"]
+        or grade.get("reference", {}).get("epoch") != 5
+        or grade.get("paired_component_bootstrap", {}).get("resamples") != 2000
+        or grade.get("paired_component_bootstrap", {}).get("seed") != 271828
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("official grade JSON does not bind the original metric and endpoints")
+    for label, endpoint, binding in (
+        ("wide", grade["reference"], wide_binding),
+        ("deep", grade["endpoint"], deep_binding),
+    ):
+        if any(
+            endpoint.get(field) != binding.get(binding_field)
+            for field, binding_field in (
+                ("checkpoint_sha256", "checkpoint_sha256"),
+                ("prediction_sha256", "prediction_sha256"),
+                ("sidecar_sha256", "sidecar_sha256"),
+            )
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(f"official grade hashes do not match the {label} fit/export chain")
+    return (
+        _finite_wp(grade["endpoint"].get("score", {}).get("wp"), "deep"),
+        _finite_wp(grade["reference"].get("score", {}).get("wp"), "wide"),
+    )
+

+def _verify_pair(
+    root: Path,
+    recovery: Path,
+    fold: int,
+    seed: int,
+    jobs: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
+    grader: Any,
+    placement_verifier: Callable[[Path, dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]], dict[str, Any]],
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Verify official grade JSON against both recovered checkpoints and exports."""
+    wide = _fit_export(root, recovery, jobs["wide"], placement_verifier)
+    deep = _fit_export(root, recovery, jobs["deep"], placement_verifier)
+    grade_root = recovery / "grades" / f"seed{seed}" / f"fold{fold}"
+    receipt_path, grade_path, command_path = (
+        grade_root / "grade_receipt.json",
+        grade_root / "grade.json",
+        grade_root / "grade_command.json",
+    )
+    receipt, grade, command = (
+        read_json(receipt_path),
+        read_json(grade_path),
+        read_json(command_path),
+    )
+    split_path = root / "splits" / f"fold{fold}.json"
+    split_sha = sha256_file(split_path)
+    if (
+        receipt.get("schema") != "tabdata-r01-delivery-grade.v2"
+        or receipt.get("status") != "graded"
+        or receipt.get("candidate") != jobs["deep"]["id"]
+        or receipt.get("reference") != jobs["wide"]["id"]
+        or receipt.get("fold") != fold
+        or receipt.get("seed") != seed
+        or receipt.get("metric_id") != METRIC_ID
+        or receipt.get("grade_path") != str(grade_path)
+        or receipt.get("grade_sha256") != sha256_file(grade_path)
+        or receipt.get("command_sha256") != sha256_file(command_path)
+        or receipt.get("stdout_sha256") != sha256_file(grade_root / "grade.stdout.txt")
+        or receipt.get("stderr_sha256") != sha256_file(grade_root / "grade.stderr.txt")
+        or isinstance(receipt.get("elapsed_seconds"), bool)
+        or not isinstance(receipt.get("elapsed_seconds"), (int, float))
+        or not math.isfinite(receipt.get("elapsed_seconds"))
+        or receipt.get("elapsed_seconds") <= 0
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("recovery grade receipt schema, cell, or file hashes are invalid")
+    if (
+        command.get("schema") != "tabdata-r01-delivery-grade-command.v2"
+        or command.get("candidate") != jobs["deep"]["id"]
+        or command.get("reference") != jobs["wide"]["id"]
+        or command.get("fold") != fold
+        or command.get("seed") != seed
+        or command.get("epoch") != 5
+        or command.get("grader_sha256") != GRADER_SHA256
+        or command.get("wide_fit_recovery_sha256") != wide["fit_sha256"]
+        or command.get("deep_fit_recovery_sha256") != deep["fit_sha256"]
+        or command.get("wide_export_receipt_sha256")
+        != sha256_file(wide["output"] / "export_receipt.json")
+        or command.get("deep_export_receipt_sha256")
+        != sha256_file(deep["output"] / "export_receipt.json")
+        or command.get("split_sha256") != split_sha
+        or command.get("cuda_disabled") is not True
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("stored grade command is not bound to the exact recovered pair")
+    argv = command.get("argv")
+    if not isinstance(argv, list) or any(not isinstance(value, str) for value in argv):
+        raise ValueError("stored grade argv is malformed")
+    expected_flags = {
+        "--root": str(grade_root / "view"),
+        "--run": jobs["deep"]["id"],
+        "--split": str(split_path),
+        "--epoch": "5",
+        "--reference": jobs["wide"]["id"] + "@5",
+        "--output": str(grade_path),
+        "--bootstrap": "2000",
+        "--scratch-dir": str(grade_root / "scratch"),
+    }
+    if argv[1] != str(root / "runtime/b300-r01-v1/grader/grade_endpoint.py") or any(
+        _flag(argv, flag) != value for flag, value in expected_flags.items()
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("stored grade argv differs from the unchanged original grader call")
+    view = grade_root / "view"
+    split = grader.load_campaign_split(split_path, view)
+    groups = list(split.evaluation_groups)
+    if (
+        split.fold != fold
+        or split.sha256 != split_sha
+        or grade.get("evaluation_row_groups") != groups
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("official grade evaluation membership differs from the frozen fold")
+    predictions = {}
+    for arm, item in (("wide", wide), ("deep", deep)):
+        _prediction, binding = grader.validate_prediction(view, item["job"]["id"], 5, groups, split)
+        if (
+            binding.get("checkpoint_sha256") != item["identity"].get("fixed_file_sha256")
+            or binding.get("prediction_sha256") != item["export_receipt"].get("prediction_sha256")
+            or binding.get("sidecar_sha256") != item["export_receipt"].get("sidecar_sha256")
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(f"original grader prediction validator rejected {arm} endpoint")
+        predictions[arm] = binding
+    deep_wp, wide_wp = _verify_grade_bindings(
+        grade,
+        fold,
+        split_sha,
+        groups,
+        jobs["wide"],
+        jobs["deep"],
+        predictions["wide"],
+        predictions["deep"],
+    )
+    receipt_score = receipt.get("score", {})
+    if (
+        _finite_wp(receipt_score.get("deep_wp"), "recovery deep") != deep_wp
+        or _finite_wp(receipt_score.get("wide_wp"), "recovery wide") != wide_wp
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("recovery grade receipt scores differ from the official grade JSON")
+    pair_id = f"r01-fold{fold}-seed{seed}"
+    endpoints_report = {}
+    for arm, item, score in (("wide", wide, wide_wp), ("deep", deep, deep_wp)):
+        job_id = item["job"]["id"]
+        run = root / "runs" / job_id
+        export_output = item["output"]
+        evidence_paths = [
+            root / "splits" / f"fold{fold}.json",
+            item["fit_path"],
+            recovery / "receipts" / f"{job_id}.export.json",
+            item["output"] / "export_receipt.json",
+            item["output"] / "export_command.json",
+            item["output"] / "export_cell_resource_receipt.json",
+            recovery / "logs" / f"{job_id}.export.log",
+            run / "command.json",
+            run / "adapter_preflight.json",
+            run / "producer_receipt.json",
+            run / "train_cell_resource_receipt.json",
+            run / "artifacts/runs" / job_id / "history.json",
+            run / "artifacts/runs" / job_id / "provenance.json",
+            export_output / "cache" / f"pred_{job_id}_valid.json",
+            grade_root / "grade_receipt.json",
+            grade_path,
+            command_path,
+            grade_root / "grade.stdout.txt",
+            grade_root / "grade.stderr.txt",
+            recovery / "fit_views" / job_id / "producer_receipt.json",
+        ]
+        safe_evidence = [
+            str(path.resolve(strict=True))
+            for path in evidence_paths
+            if not path.is_symlink() and path.is_file() and path.resolve().is_relative_to(root)
+        ]
+        artifact = run / "artifacts/runs" / job_id
+        weights = [artifact / name for name in ("model_ep5.pt", "model.pt", "training_state.pt")]
+        safe_weights = [
+            str(path.resolve(strict=True))
+            for path in weights
+            if path.is_file() and not path.is_symlink()
+        ]
+        endpoints_report[arm] = {
+            "id": job_id,
+            "arm": arm,
+            "wp": score,
+            "checkpoint_sha256": item["identity"]["fixed_file_sha256"],
+            "prediction_sha256": predictions[arm]["prediction_sha256"],
+            "sidecar_sha256": predictions[arm]["sidecar_sha256"],
+            "fit_recovery_sha256": item["fit_sha256"],
+            "export_recovery_sha256": item["export_sha256"],
+            "evidence_paths": sorted(set(safe_evidence)),
+            "weights_paths": safe_weights,
+        }
+    return {
+        "id": pair_id,
+        "pair_id": pair_id,
+        "fold": fold,
+        "seed": seed,
+        "metric_id": METRIC_ID,
+        "split_manifest_sha256": split_sha,
+        "wide_wp": wide_wp,
+        "deep_wp": deep_wp,
+        "delta_wp": deep_wp - wide_wp,
+        "receipt_sha256": sha256_file(receipt_path),
+        "grade_sha256": sha256_file(grade_path),
+        "grade_command_sha256": sha256_file(command_path),
+        "endpoints": endpoints_report,
+    }

+def collect(root: Path, config: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Read and independently validate completed recovery grades without running phases."""
+    root = root.resolve(strict=True)
+    panel, source_root, placement_verifier = _verify_runtime(root, config)
+    grader = _load_grader(root, source_root)
+    pairs = _job_map(panel)
+    recovery = root / "state/r01-delivery-recovery-v2"
+    completed, errors, active = [], [], set()
+    for (fold, seed), jobs in sorted(pairs.items()):
+        grade_root = recovery / "grades" / f"seed{seed}" / f"fold{fold}"
+        receipt_path = grade_root / "grade_receipt.json"
+        if not receipt_path.exists() and not receipt_path.is_symlink():
+            if any(
+                (recovery / "receipts" / f"{job['id']}.export.json").exists()
+                for job in jobs.values()
+            ):
+                active.add((fold, seed))
+            continue
+        try:
+            completed.append(
+                _verify_pair(root, recovery, fold, seed, jobs, grader, placement_verifier)
+            )
+        except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError, RuntimeError) as error:
+            errors.append(f"fold{fold}/seed{seed}: {type(error).__name__}: {error}")
+    complete_cells = {(row["fold"], row["seed"]) for row in completed}
+    failed_cells = {
+        (int(m[1]), int(m[2]))
+        for error in errors
+        if (m := re.search(r"fold(\d+)/seed(\d+)", error))
+    }
+    active -= complete_cells | failed_cells
+    source = {
+        "panel_sha256": PANEL_SHA256,
+        "actor_bundle_sha256": ACTOR_SHA256,
+        "source_tree_identity_sha256": SOURCE_TREE_SHA256,
+        "grader_sha256": GRADER_SHA256,
+        "helper_manifest_sha256": ACTIVE_HELPER_MANIFEST_SHA256,
+        "historical_helper_manifest_sha256": HELPER_MANIFEST_SHA256,
+    }
+    return {
+        "schema": "tabdata-r01-delivery-recovery-report.v2",
+        "experiment_id": EXPERIMENT_ID,
+        "expected_cells": 30,
+        "expected_per_arm": 30,
+        "completed": sorted(completed, key=lambda row: (row["fold"], row["seed"])),
+        "active": len(active),
+        "pending": max(0, 30 - len(complete_cells) - len(active) - len(failed_cells)),
+        "terminal": len(complete_cells) == 30 and not errors,
+        "source": source,
+        "metric_id": METRIC_ID,
+        "errors": errors[:100],
+        "contract_note": (
+            "Distinct delivery-recovery scope for already completed original E-B300-R01 fits. "
+            "No refits were performed by this reporter. This source-qualified recovery status "
+            "does not replace or edit the existing full-panel R01 status comment on PR25."
+        ),
+    }

+def _canonical_sha(value: object) -> str:
+    """Hash canonical JSON for durable comment markers."""
+    return hashlib.sha256(
+        json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode()
+    ).hexdigest()
+
+
+def _write_new_json(path: Path, value: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+    """Durably publish one immutable JSON outbox item without replacement."""
+    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    if path.exists() or path.is_symlink():
+        raise FileExistsError(f"outbox item already exists: {path}")
+    descriptor, temporary = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=".recovery-outbox-", dir=path.parent)
+    try:
+        with os.fdopen(descriptor, "w", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
+            json.dump(value, stream, sort_keys=True, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
+            stream.write("\n")
+            stream.flush()
+            os.fsync(stream.fileno())
+        os.link(temporary, path)
+        directory_fd = os.open(path.parent, os.O_RDONLY)
+        try:
+            os.fsync(directory_fd)
+        finally:
+            os.close(directory_fd)
+    finally:
+        if os.path.exists(temporary):
+            os.unlink(temporary)
+

+def _marker(kind: str, digest: str = "") -> str:
+    """Create markers in a namespace separate from the full-panel R01 publisher."""
+    return f"<!-- tabdata-b300-20261018:{EXPERIMENT_ID}:{kind}:{digest} -->"

+def render(
+    snapshot: dict[str, Any], *, rows: list[dict[str, Any]] | None, evidence_url: str
+) -> str:
+    """Render a compact, source-qualified status or paired-results comment."""
+    kind = "status" if rows is None else "results"
+    marker = _marker(kind, "" if rows is None else _canonical_sha(rows))
+    by_fold: dict[int, list[float]] = defaultdict(list)
+    for row in snapshot["completed"]:
+        by_fold[row["fold"]].append(row["delta_wp"])
+    delta = (
+        None
+        if not by_fold
+        else sum(sum(values) / len(values) for values in by_fold.values()) / len(by_fold)
+    )
+    label = (
+        "complete delivery evidence"
+        if snapshot["terminal"]
+        else "partial recovery delivery evidence"
+    )
+    lines = [
+        marker,
+        f"### {EXPERIMENT_ID}: {kind} update",
+        f"**Status:** {label}; paired official grades {len(snapshot['completed'])}/30; delivery-pending {snapshot['pending']}; in-progress {snapshot['active']}.",
+        snapshot["contract_note"],
+        "This report uses a separate recovery marker; it does not replace or edit the existing full-panel R01 status comment on PR25. It records delivery-only recovery of already trained fixed-epoch-5 checkpoints and does not count additional fits.",
+        f"Official metric `{METRIC_ID}`; equal-fold mean of observed paired deep-minus-wide deltas: `{('not available' if delta is None else f'{delta:+.8f}')}`. All four folds are exposed; this is descriptive evidence, not a pristine holdout or a significance claim.",
+        f"Source pins: `{json.dumps(snapshot['source'], sort_keys=True)}`.",
+        f"Contract and recovery evidence: {evidence_url}",
+    ]
+    if rows is not None:
+        lines.append(f"**New scored original pairs in this comment:** {len(rows)}.")
+        for row in rows:
+            lines.append(
+                _marker("pair", _canonical_sha({"id": row["id"], "receipt": row["receipt_sha256"]}))
+            )
+            lines.append(
+                f"- Fold {row['fold']}, seed {row['seed']}: wide `{row['wide_wp']:.8f}`, "
+                f"deep `{row['deep_wp']:.8f}`, delta `{row['delta_wp']:+.8f}`; "
+                f"grade receipt `{row['receipt_sha256']}`, grade `{row['grade_sha256']}`."
+            )
+            for arm in ("wide", "deep"):
+                endpoint = row["endpoints"][arm]
+                lines.append(
+                    f"  - {arm} `{endpoint['id']}` checkpoint `{endpoint['checkpoint_sha256']}`, "
+                    f"prediction `{endpoint['prediction_sha256']}`, fit recovery `{endpoint['fit_recovery_sha256']}`, "
+                    f"export recovery `{endpoint['export_recovery_sha256']}`."
+                )
+                archive = endpoint.get("archives", {})
+                if archive:
+                    evidence = archive.get("evidence_archive", {})
+                    weights = archive.get("weights_archive", {})
+                    lines.append(
+                        f"    - Private archive manifest `{archive.get('archive_manifest_path')}` "
+                        f"SHA-256 `{archive.get('archive_manifest_sha256')}`; evidence "
+                        f"`{evidence.get('path')}` SHA-256 `{evidence.get('sha256')}`; weights "
+                        f"`{weights.get('path')}` SHA-256 `{weights.get('sha256')}`."
+                    )
+    if snapshot["errors"]:
+        lines.extend(
+            [
+                "**Rejected or incomplete receipt chains retained:**",
+                *[f"- {error[:500]}" for error in snapshot["errors"][:12]],
+            ]
+        )
+    lines.append(
+        "The reporting process reads receipts and archives evidence/weights privately; it never trains, exports, or grades."
+    )
+    return "\n\n".join(lines)
+

+def _load_github(code_dir: Path, expected_manifest_sha: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Load pinned GitHub/archive APIs into this isolated one-shot reporter process."""
+    manifest_path = code_dir / "CODE_MANIFEST.json"
+    if sha256_file(manifest_path) != expected_manifest_sha:
+        raise ValueError("github-reporting-v1 helper manifest differs from its pin")
+    manifest = read_json(manifest_path)
+    for name, digest in manifest.get("files", {}).items():
+        if (
+            Path(name).name != name
+            or not name.endswith(".py")
+            or sha256_file(code_dir / name) != digest
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(f"pinned GitHub reporting helper changed: {name}")
+    names = ("github_api", "package_evidence", "render_report", "report_state")
+    for name in names:
+        sys.modules.pop(name, None)
+    sys.path.insert(0, str(code_dir))
+    import importlib
+
+    return {name: importlib.import_module(name) for name in names}

+def _own_comments(comments: list[dict[str, Any]], login: str) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    """Only reconcile comments authored by the configured account."""
+    return [comment for comment in comments if comment.get("user", {}).get("login") == login]
+
+
+def _publish(
+    client: Any,
+    helpers: dict[str, Any],
+    root: Path,
+    snapshot: dict[str, Any],
+    config: dict[str, Any],
+    cursor: dict[str, Any],
+) -> None:
+    """Reconcile and publish up to eight new pairs plus this recovery scope's status."""
+    metadata = client.request("GET", f"/repos/{REPOSITORY}/pulls/{PR_NUMBER}")
+    if (
+        metadata["state"] != "open"
+        or metadata["base"]["ref"] != "research-team"
+        or metadata["head"]["ref"] != HEAD_REF
+        or metadata["base"]["repo"]["full_name"] != REPOSITORY
+        or metadata["head"]["repo"]["full_name"] != REPOSITORY
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("PR25 identity is not the fixed R01 draft target")
+    comments = _own_comments(client.comments(PR_NUMBER), config["publisher_login"])
+    acknowledged = cursor.setdefault("pairs", {})
+    for comment in comments:
+        body = comment.get("body", "")
+        for row in snapshot["completed"]:
+            pair_marker = _marker(
+                "pair", _canonical_sha({"id": row["id"], "receipt": row["receipt_sha256"]})
+            )
+            if pair_marker in body:
+                acknowledged[row["id"]] = row["receipt_sha256"]
+    pending = [
+        row for row in snapshot["completed"] if acknowledged.get(row["id"]) != row["receipt_sha256"]
+    ]
+    evidence_url = config["evidence_url"]
+    for row in pending[:8]:
+        archived = {}
+        for arm in ("wide", "deep"):
+            endpoint = row["endpoints"][arm]
+            archive_row = {
+                "id": endpoint["id"],
+                "receipt_sha256": row["receipt_sha256"],
+                "evidence_paths": _archive_evidence_paths(
+                    root,
+                    row["fold"],
+                    row["split_manifest_sha256"],
+                    endpoint["evidence_paths"],
+                ),
+                "weights_paths": endpoint["weights_paths"],
+            }
+            archived[arm] = helpers["package_evidence"].ensure_archives(root, archive_row)
+            endpoint["archives"] = archived[arm]
+        row["archives"] = archived
+    new_rows = pending[:8]
+    if new_rows:
+        batch_marker = _marker("results", _canonical_sha(new_rows))
+        existing = next(
+            (comment for comment in comments if batch_marker in comment.get("body", "")), None
+        )
+        if existing is None:
+            existing = client.post(
+                PR_NUMBER, render(snapshot, rows=new_rows, evidence_url=evidence_url)
+            )
+        for row in new_rows:
+            acknowledged[row["id"]] = row["receipt_sha256"]
+        cursor.setdefault("result_urls", [])
+        if existing.get("html_url") not in cursor["result_urls"]:
+            cursor["result_urls"].append(existing["html_url"])
+    status_marker = _marker("status")
+    status = next(
+        (comment for comment in comments if status_marker in comment.get("body", "")), None
+    )
+    body = render(snapshot, rows=None, evidence_url=evidence_url)
+    status = client.post(PR_NUMBER, body) if status is None else client.patch(status["id"], body)
+    cursor["status_url"] = status["html_url"]
+    cursor["snapshot_sha256"] = _canonical_sha(snapshot)
+    cursor["last_success_unix"] = time.time()
+
+
+def run(root: Path, config: dict[str, Any]) -> int:
+    """Collect receipts, persist an outbox, and publish only to the fixed PR25 scope."""
+    import fcntl
+
+    root = root.resolve(strict=True)
+    if config.get("root") != str(root) or config.get("repository") != REPOSITORY:
+        raise ValueError("reporter root or repository differs from the fixed scope")
+    github_code_dir = root / "runtime/github-reporting-v1/code"
+    if (
+        str(root) != PROJECT_ROOT
+        or Path(config["github_code_dir"]) != github_code_dir
+        or config.get("github_code_manifest_sha256") != GITHUB_CODE_MANIFEST_SHA256
+        or Path(config["token_file"]) != root / "private/github-reporting-v1/github.token"
+        or type(config.get("execute_enabled")) is not bool
+    ):
+        raise ValueError(
+            "publisher helper, credential path, or host scope differs from its fixed pin"
+        )
+    recovery_root = root / "state/r01-delivery-recovery-v2"
+    if (
+        config.get("pr_number") != PR_NUMBER
+        or config.get("head_ref") != HEAD_REF
+        or config.get("publisher_login") != PUBLISHER_LOGIN
+        or Path(config["helper_manifest_path"])
+        != root / "runtime/r01-delivery-recovery-v2_4/MANIFEST.json"
+        or config.get("helper_manifest_sha256") != ACTIVE_HELPER_MANIFEST_SHA256
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("reporter target or active v2.4 helper pin differs from the fixed scope")
+    state_root = root / "state/r01-delivery-recovery-v2/publisher-v1"
+    if recovery_root.is_symlink() or state_root.is_symlink():
+        raise ValueError("recovery reporter state root cannot be a symlink")
+    state_root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    lock_path = state_root / "publisher.lock"
+    if lock_path.is_symlink():
+        raise ValueError("recovery reporter lock cannot be a symlink")
+    with lock_path.open("a") as lock:
+        try:
+            fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
+        except BlockingIOError:
+            return 0
+        snapshot = collect(root, config)
+        outbox_dir = state_root / "outbox"
+        if outbox_dir.is_symlink():
+            raise ValueError("recovery reporter outbox cannot be a symlink")
+        outbox_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+        outbox_path = outbox_dir / f"{_canonical_sha(snapshot)}.json"
+        if not outbox_path.exists() and not outbox_path.is_symlink():
+            _write_new_json(outbox_path, snapshot)
+        elif read_json(outbox_path) != snapshot:
+            raise ValueError("existing recovery outbox differs from the current snapshot")
+        if not config.get("execute_enabled"):
+            return 0
+        if time.time() > config.get("expires_unix", 0):
+            raise ValueError("recovery reporter configuration has expired")
+        helpers = _load_github(
+            Path(config["github_code_dir"]), config["github_code_manifest_sha256"]
+        )
+        client = helpers["github_api"].GitHub(
+            helpers["github_api"].read_token(Path(config["token_file"])), request_limit=24
+        )
+        user = client.request("GET", "/user")
+        if user.get("login") != PUBLISHER_LOGIN:
+            raise ValueError("GitHub account differs from the configured publisher")
+        cursor_path = state_root / "CURSOR.json"
+        cursor = helpers["report_state"].read_json(cursor_path, {"pairs": {}, "result_urls": []})
+        _publish(client, helpers, root, snapshot, config, cursor)
+        helpers["report_state"].write_json(cursor_path, cursor)
+        helpers["report_state"].append_event(
+            state_root / "publications.jsonl",
+            "published",
+            experiment_id=EXPERIMENT_ID,
+            completed=len(snapshot["completed"]),
+            outbox_sha256=_canonical_sha(snapshot),
+        )
+        return 0
+
+
+def verify_config(path: Path, expected_sha256: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Require the service-pinned config for the fixed recovery reporter."""
+    if sha256_file(path) != expected_sha256:
+        raise ValueError("R01 recovery reporter configuration differs from its service pin")
+    config = read_json(path)
+    if (
+        config.get("schema") != "tabdata-r01-recovery-reporter-config.v1"
+        or config.get("repository") != REPOSITORY
+        or config.get("pr_number") != PR_NUMBER
+        or config.get("head_ref") != HEAD_REF
+        or config.get("publisher_login") != PUBLISHER_LOGIN
+        or config.get("helper_manifest_sha256") != ACTIVE_HELPER_MANIFEST_SHA256
+        or config.get("github_code_manifest_sha256") != GITHUB_CODE_MANIFEST_SHA256
+        or config.get("root") != PROJECT_ROOT
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("R01 recovery reporter config is outside its fixed source-qualified scope")
+    return config
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    """Run one bounded receipt collection and publication pass."""
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--config", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--config-sha256", required=True)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    config = verify_config(args.config, args.config_sha256)
+    return run(Path(config["root"]), config)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+"""Observe, validate, export, and grade frozen R01 fits without a fit path."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import sys
+import time
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+from delivery_watch_core import (
+    EXPECTED_DEADLINE_UNIX,
+    HELPER_MANIFEST_SHA256,
+    PANEL_SHA256,
+    POLL_SECONDS,
+    append_event,
+    read_object,
+    sha256_file,
+    verify_helper_bundle,
+    verify_runtime_envelope,
+    verify_watcher_files,
+    write_atomic,
+)
+from delivery_watch_grades import _grade_pair, _publish
+from delivery_watch_phases import _export_one, _fit_one
+from delivery_watch_state import _cell_load
+
+
+def _load_config(path: Path, expected_sha256: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Check the root-supplied config, helper bundle, and frozen panel."""
+    if sha256_file(path) != expected_sha256:
+        raise ValueError("watcher config SHA-256 differs from the service pin")
+    config = read_object(path)
+    required = {
+        "root",
+        "helper_dir",
+        "helper_manifest_name",
+        "helper_manifest_sha256",
+        "absolute_deadline_unix",
+        "gpu_uuid",
+        "publisher_config_path",
+        "publisher_config_sha256",
+        "watcher_files",
+    }
+    if (
+        config.get("schema") != "tabdata-r01-delivery-watch-config.v1"
+        or not required.issubset(config)
+        or config["helper_manifest_name"] != "MANIFEST.json"
+        or config["absolute_deadline_unix"] != EXPECTED_DEADLINE_UNIX
+        or config["helper_manifest_sha256"] != HELPER_MANIFEST_SHA256
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("watcher config schema, helper pin, or fixed deadline is invalid")
+    script_dir = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+    verify_watcher_files(script_dir, config["watcher_files"])
+    root = Path(config["root"]).resolve(strict=True)
+    helper = Path(config["helper_dir"]).resolve(strict=True)
+    expected_helper = (root / "runtime/r01-delivery-recovery-v2_4").resolve(strict=True)
+    if helper != expected_helper:
+        raise ValueError("helper directory differs from runtime/r01-delivery-recovery-v2_4")
+    verify_helper_bundle(helper, config["helper_manifest_sha256"])
+    packet = root / "runtime/b300-r01-v1"
+    panel_path = packet / "PANEL.json"
+    if sha256_file(panel_path) != PANEL_SHA256:
+        raise ValueError("frozen R01 panel hash differs from the reviewed panel")
+    jobs = read_object(panel_path).get("jobs")
+    if not isinstance(jobs, list) or len(jobs) != 60 or len({j.get("id") for j in jobs}) != 60:
+        raise ValueError("frozen R01 panel must contain exactly 60 unique cells")
+    return {
+        **config,
+        "root_path": root,
+        "helper_path": helper,
+        "packet_path": packet,
+        "jobs": jobs,
+    }
+
+
+def _summary(cells: dict[str, dict[str, Any]]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Summarize delivery outcomes without treating fit failures as scores."""
+    fits = [c.get("fit", {}).get("status", "pending") for c in cells.values()]
+    exports = [c.get("export", {}).get("status", "pending") for c in cells.values()]
+    grades = [c.get("grade", {}).get("status", "pending") for c in cells.values()]
+    return {
+        "fit_counts": {
+            s: fits.count(s)
+            for s in ("validated", "rejected", "preserved_partial", "pending", "validation_started")
+        },
+        "export_counts": {
+            s: exports.count(s)
+            for s in (
+                "exported",
+                "rejected",
+                "preserved_partial",
+                "not_applicable",
+                "pending",
+                "export_started",
+            )
+        },
+        "fit_terminal_count": sum(
+            s in {"validated", "rejected", "preserved_partial"} for s in fits
+        ),
+        "export_terminal_count": sum(
+            s in {"exported", "rejected", "preserved_partial", "not_applicable"} for s in exports
+        ),
+        "grade_count": grades.count("graded"),
+        "grade_terminal_count": sum(
+            s in {"graded", "preserved_partial", "not_applicable"} for s in grades
+        ),
+        "scores_claimed": grades.count("graded"),
+    }
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    """Run the finite delivery monitor under its separately bounded service unit."""
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--config", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--config-sha256", required=True)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    config = _load_config(args.config, args.config_sha256)
+    verify_runtime_envelope(str(config["gpu_uuid"]))
+    root, helper = config["root_path"], config["helper_path"]
+    recovery = root / "state/r01-delivery-recovery-v2"
+    if recovery.is_symlink() or not recovery.is_dir():
+        raise ValueError("recovery tree must be an existing nonsymlink directory")
+    state = root / "state/r01-delivery-watch-v1"
+    if state.is_symlink():
+        raise ValueError("watcher state cannot be a symlink")
+    state.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    import fcntl
+
+    lock = (state / "watcher.lock").open("a+")
+    try:
+        fcntl.flock(lock.fileno(), fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
+    except OSError as error:
+        lock.close()
+        raise RuntimeError("another delivery watcher already owns this state") from error
+    sys.path.insert(0, str(helper))
+    from r01_recovery_delivery import grade_pair
+    from r01_recovery_placement import verify_placement
+
+    delivery = sys.modules["r01_recovery_delivery"]
+    jobs = config["jobs"]
+    cells = {str(job["id"]): _cell_load(state, job) for job in jobs}
+    stable: dict[str, tuple[str, float]] = {}
+    last_publish = 0.0
+    append_event(
+        state / "events.jsonl",
+        {
+            "time_unix": time.time(),
+            "phase": "watcher_started",
+            "panel_sha256": PANEL_SHA256,
+            "deadline_unix": EXPECTED_DEADLINE_UNIX,
+        },
+    )
+    while time.time() < EXPECTED_DEADLINE_UNIX:
+        for job in jobs:
+            cell = cells[str(job["id"])]
+            if cell.get("fit", {}).get("status") in {"pending", "validation_started"}:
+                _fit_one(config, state, recovery, job, cell, stable, delivery, verify_placement)
+            if cell.get("export", {}).get("status") in {"pending", "export_started"}:
+                _export_one(config, state, recovery, job, cell, delivery, verify_placement)
+            last_publish = _publish(config, state, force=False, last_time=last_publish)
+        pairs: dict[tuple[int, int], dict[str, Any]] = {}
+        for job in jobs:
+            pairs.setdefault((int(job["fold"]), int(job["seed"])), {})[str(job["arm"])] = job
+        for (fold, seed), pair in sorted(pairs.items()):
+            if set(pair) != {"wide", "deep"}:
+                raise ValueError(f"frozen panel pair is malformed at fold {fold}, seed {seed}")
+            last_publish = _grade_pair(
+                config,
+                state,
+                recovery,
+                pair["wide"],
+                pair["deep"],
+                cells,
+                grade_pair,
+                last_publish,
+            )
+        last_publish = _publish(config, state, force=False, last_time=last_publish)
+        summary = _summary(cells)
+        write_atomic(
+            state / "STATUS.json",
+            {
+                "schema": "tabdata-r01-delivery-watch-status.v1",
+                "heartbeat_unix": time.time(),
+                "panel_sha256": PANEL_SHA256,
+                "deadline_unix": EXPECTED_DEADLINE_UNIX,
+                **summary,
+            },
+        )
+        if (
+            summary["fit_terminal_count"] == 60
+            and summary["export_terminal_count"] == 60
+            and summary["grade_terminal_count"] == 30
+        ):
+            break
+        seconds_left = max(0, int(EXPECTED_DEADLINE_UNIX - time.time()))
+        if seconds_left <= 0:
+            break
+        time.sleep(min(POLL_SECONDS, seconds_left))
+    summary = _summary(cells)
+    complete = (
+        summary["fit_counts"]["validated"] == 60
+        and summary["export_counts"]["exported"] == 60
+        and summary["grade_count"] == 30
+    )
+    write_atomic(
+        state / "RESULT.json",
+        {
+            "schema": "tabdata-r01-delivery-watch-result.v1",
+            "status": "complete" if complete else "partial",
+            "finished_unix": time.time(),
+            "panel_sha256": PANEL_SHA256,
+            **summary,
+        },
+    )
+    append_event(
+        state / "events.jsonl", {"time_unix": time.time(), "phase": "watcher_finished", **summary}
+    )
+    lock.close()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+    own_comments = [{"id": 9, "body": old_status, "user": {"login": publisher.PUBLISHER_LOGIN}}]
+
+    class FakeClient:
+        def __init__(self) -> None:
+            self.posts: list[tuple[int, str]] = []
+            self.patches: list[int] = []
+
+        def request(self, _method: str, path: str) -> dict:
+            assert path == f"/repos/{publisher.REPOSITORY}/pulls/{publisher.PR_NUMBER}"
+            return {
+                "state": "open",
+                "base": {"ref": "research-team", "repo": {"full_name": publisher.REPOSITORY}},
+                "head": {"ref": publisher.HEAD_REF, "repo": {"full_name": publisher.REPOSITORY}},
+            }
+
+        def comments(self, number: int) -> list[dict]:
+            assert number == 25
+            return own_comments
+
+        def post(self, number: int, body: str) -> dict:
+            self.posts.append((number, body))
+            return {"id": 10, "html_url": "https://example.test/recovery-status"}
+
+        def patch(self, comment_id: int, _body: str) -> dict:
+            self.patches.append(comment_id)
+            return {"id": comment_id, "html_url": "https://example.test/old-status"}
+
+    client = FakeClient()
+    cursor: dict = {"pairs": {}, "result_urls": []}
+    publisher._publish(
+        client,
+        {},
+        Path("."),
+        snapshot,
+        {"publisher_login": publisher.PUBLISHER_LOGIN, "evidence_url": "https://example.test"},
+        cursor,
+    )
+    assert len(client.posts) == 1 and client.posts[0][0] == 25
+    assert publisher._marker("status") in client.posts[0][1]
+    assert "does not replace or edit the existing full-panel" in client.posts[0][1]
+    assert client.patches == []

+  "body": "# [Experiment] trajectory-average: Fixed checkpoint trajectory averaging\n\n1. **Status, lineage and ownership**\n\n   Implementation handoff / proposed comparison, not a fitted result. Lineage: **student**. IDs: `H-DRAFT-TRAJECTORY-AVERAGE-20261017`, `E-DRAFT-TRAJECTORY-AVERAGE-20261017-R1`. Author/source: team repository plus this October17 draft, based on main/research-team `18407ecfa3b02d4db70cfb3c34abbacd6653e79d`. Receiving researcher owns device adaptation, source-clean bindings, profiling and complete run/evaluation return. New code in this PR: none; reuse linked existing implementation, preserving original source.\n\n2. **Why it should work**\n\n   Averaging a fixed optimizer trajectory may improve a deterministic endpoint without extra fitting. Expect stable cross-fold endpoint gain over the same final checkpoint. The strongest general alternative is extra capacity, changed optimization or target calibration rather than the proposed mechanism; freeze the indicated matched controls. Current source evidence: Two F0seed trajectory averages constructed; export/grade pending.\n\n3. **Where more compute buys quality**\n\n   More compute buys complete fitting horizons, the30 paired cells, clean teacher cohorts and explicit capacity/context ladders; there is no measured scaling law. For student mechanisms use a single card per fit when it fits, and compare downstream official student/blend quality rather than teacher score alone. Large Transformer teachers can use multiple cards and207M/682M starting branches, with1.65B/long-context extensions conditional on evidence and memory. Do not assume all8 cards accelerate a small GRU. No leaderboard impact is measured or numerically predicted.\n\n4. **Frozen comparison and training proposal**\n\n   Arms: `fixed-final-checkpoint`, `fixed-trajectory-average`. All use FP32 parameters, activations, states, gradients and optimizer state; autocast and TF32 off, no quantization. The adjacent recipe records **starting proposals**, not a final frozen training command: AdamW, preclip norm1,12-epoch WSD with2% warmup and20% cooldown to0.1\u00d7LR. Proposed peak LR is 0.001, with parameter-group decay exclusions for biases/norms/gates to be recorded. Exact batch/accumulation/context, source-matched targets, inner checkpoint policy and successful-update count must be bound before fits. Changing the historical FP16/two-epoch recipe to this route is an explicit successor, not a faithful rerun. Scale/context/horizon sweeps are separate frozen arms, not post-result tuning hidden within these30 cells.\n\n5. **Thirty paired runs**\n\n   Each scientific arm uses F0/F1 seeds1001\u20131008 and F2/F3 seeds1001\u20131007:30 fits per arm. Candidate/control share cells and membership. Source-clean ancestors, normalizers and cache hashes must be bound independently for every fold; old F0 parents cannot simply be reused across folds. No runs in this matrix have started. `60` fits are required for all named arms; this is a plan, not a compute allocation.\n\n6. **Validation and statistical significance**\n\n   Official `global_wp_clip2_v1`, unchanged \u00b12 evaluation clipping and original clipped-label magnitude weights. Primary statistic: one quarter times each fold's mean paired endpoint WP delta, then summed; compute scores per fit, not from seed-averaged predictions. Use the [workflow's seed/component procedures](https://github.com/VladKochetov007/WunderFunder/blob/experiment/trajectory-average/research/unified/methods/EXPERIMENT_DRAFT_WORKFLOW_20261017_R1.md),10000 resamples, RNG17017. Separate conditional component uncertainty, fitting-seed variability, observed-fold sensitivity and unknown public transfer. Specify primary contrasts/multiplicity (Holm within frozen primary contrast family) before results. Thirty cells do not ensure power; do not treat rows, overlapping fits or four folds as many independent markets. All existing folds are exposed.\n\n7. **Future leakage and representative validation**\n\n   Inputs/feature transforms must be causal with sequence reset and fitting-only scaling. Audit source-qualified component overlap, aliases and teacher/initializer/preprocessing ancestry. True competition labels may reference future horizons; AR feedback accepts only own predictions. Check prefix invariance, reset/reload and intended chunk semantics before expensive runs. Report by source, fold, target, sequence position and activity/target-magnitude regimes; unknown anonymous clocks limit forward-market claims. No clean-validation claim is made for reused fitted groups.\n\n8. **Decision-changing outcome**\n\n   **Useful-effect threshold is deliberately pending**, to be justified from baseline variance, student transfer and GPU cost before fits. Success: a practically useful paired endpoint gain with acceptable fold/seed behavior and relevant downstream transfer. Uncertainty: an unresolved effect or heterogeneous regimes can justify a bounded targeted follow-up. Negative result: no useful gain or a concrete failure mode narrows this recipe; an interval crossing0 does not close the whole direction. Record whether the result changes teacher, student or target-link allocation. No retrospective threshold selection.\n\n9. **How to run and remaining integration**\n\n   **Not a ready-to-launch full-data B300 trainer.** Rebind fixed checkpoint epochs and normalization per fold/seed; preserve existing constructed artifacts; evaluate complete FP32 endpoints.\n\n   From the repository root, install the repository's pinned Python/Torch environment on the receiving host and record the actual CUDA/driver/Torch/container identities. Mount only permitted supplied data and source-qualified split/teacher/cache assets on physical storage. Inspect actual B300 topology and FP32 kernel support; no claimed throughput or wall time. Run the implemented **plan command**:\n\n   ```bash\n   python research/experiment_drafts/trajectory-average/run_plan.py\n   ```\n\n   This prints the30-cell matrix and missing bindings; it does **not** train. Existing implementation entry points are linked below.  \n\n   A receiving-host multi-GPU teacher launch will use `torchrun --standalone --nproc_per_node=<measured_count> <completed_teacher_trainer> ...`; this is a **shape of command, not an existing executable trainer**. Existing `scripts/train_rnn.py` handles GRU fitting and exposes `--precision fp32`, `--seed`, `--valid-fold`, `--split-manifest`, `--grad-stats`, `--save-training-state`; keep its cache/provenance validation. No automatic launch or queue is provided. For initializer work reuse the linked phase runner rather than pretending it accepts generic trainer flags. Resume only from matching source/config and complete optimizer/scheduler/RNG/sampler/state, otherwise restart a declared boundary.\n\n10. **Evidence and archives to return**\n\n   Explicitly hook `wnn.research_reporting.RunRecorder`; it does not instrument trainers automatically. Save source/config/ancestry/environment; attempted/completed steps, losses/components, param-group LR, preclip gradient norm, clipping/nonfinite counts, scores/masks/unit counts, timing/throughput and peak memory. Outer validation reports cannot choose checkpoints. Save all cells, failures, checkpoints/prediction manifests and an English terminal result note.\n\n   ```bash\n   python scripts/research_result_bundle.py --root <run_dir> --output-dir <archive_dir> \\\n     --evidence run_metadata.json --evidence metrics.jsonl \\\n     --evidence terminal_result.json --weight checkpoints/final.pt\n   ```\n\n   The explicit-file bundler writes separate evidence.tar and weights.tar plus SHA256 manifest; add prediction/grade/provenance files explicitly as more --evidence arguments. Keep datasets out. Return private archive locations/hashes separately from this PR, and keep the provenance manifests/narrative notes indexed in Git.\n\n11. **Results, provenance and merge trace**\n\n   No new fits or hardware checks; score/LB impact unknown. +  "body": "# [Experiment] causal-innovation: Causal innovation residuals beyond moment features\n\n1. **Status, lineage and ownership**\n\n   Implementation handoff / proposed comparison, not a fitted result. Lineage: **teacher/student**. IDs: `H-DRAFT-CAUSAL-INNOVATION-20261017`, `E-DRAFT-CAUSAL-INNOVATION-20261017-R1`. Author/source: team repository plus this October17 draft, based on main/research-team `18407ecfa3b02d4db70cfb3c34abbacd6653e79d`. Receiving researcher owns device adaptation, source-clean bindings, profiling and complete run/evaluation return. New code in this PR: none; reuse linked existing implementation, preserving original source.\n\n2. **Why it should work**\n\n   Residualizing observable changes against causal moments may expose signal obscured by levels. Expect innovation channels to add value beyond equal-width moments. The strongest general alternative is extra capacity, changed optimization or target calibration rather than the proposed mechanism; freeze the indicated matched controls. Current source evidence: Existing matched pair blocked on cache schema before fits; execution failure is not negative science.\n\n3. **Where more compute buys quality**\n\n   More compute buys complete fitting horizons, the30 paired cells, clean teacher cohorts and explicit capacity/context ladders; there is no measured scaling law. For student mechanisms use a single card per fit when it fits, and compare downstream official student/blend quality rather than teacher score alone. Large Transformer teachers can use multiple cards and207M/682M starting branches, with1.65B/long-context extensions conditional on evidence and memory. Do not assume all8 cards accelerate a small GRU. No leaderboard impact is measured or numerically predicted.\n\n4. **Frozen comparison and training proposal**\n\n   Arms: `matched-moments`, `moments-plus-innovation`. All use FP32 parameters, activations, states, gradients and optimizer state; autocast and TF32 off, no quantization. The adjacent recipe records **starting proposals**, not a final frozen training command: AdamW, preclip norm1,12-epoch WSD with2% warmup and20% cooldown to0.1\u00d7LR. Proposed peak LR is 0.001, with parameter-group decay exclusions for biases/norms/gates to be recorded. Exact batch/accumulation/context, source-matched targets, inner checkpoint policy and successful-update count must be bound before fits. Changing the historical FP16/two-epoch recipe to this route is an explicit successor, not a faithful rerun. Scale/context/horizon sweeps are separate frozen arms, not post-result tuning hidden within these30 cells.\n\n5. **Thirty paired runs**\n\n   Each scientific arm uses F0/F1 seeds1001\u20131008 and F2/F3 seeds1001\u20131007:30 fits per arm. Candidate/control share cells and membership. Source-clean ancestors, normalizers and cache hashes must be bound independently for every fold; old F0 parents cannot simply be reused across folds. No runs in this matrix have started. `60` fits are required for all named arms; this is a plan, not a compute allocation.\n\n6. **Validation and statistical significance**\n\n   Official `global_wp_clip2_v1`, unchanged \u00b12 evaluation clipping and original clipped-label magnitude weights. Primary statistic: one quarter times each fold's mean paired endpoint WP delta, then summed; compute scores per fit, not from seed-averaged predictions. Use the [workflow's seed/component procedures](https://github.com/VladKochetov007/WunderFunder/blob/experiment/causal-innovation/research/unified/methods/EXPERIMENT_DRAFT_WORKFLOW_20261017_R1.md),10000 resamples, RNG17017. Separate conditional component uncertainty, fitting-seed variability, observed-fold sensitivity and unknown public transfer. Specify primary contrasts/multiplicity (Holm within frozen primary contrast family) before results. Thirty cells do not ensure power; do not treat rows, overlapping fits or four folds as many independent markets. All existing folds are exposed.\n\n7. **Future leakage and representative validation**\n\n   Inputs/feature transforms must be causal with sequence reset and fitting-only scaling. Report by source, fold, target, sequence position and activity/target-magnitude regimes; unknown anonymous clocks limit forward-market claims. No clean-validation claim is made for reused fitted groups.\n\n8. **Decision-changing outcome**\n\n   **Useful-effect threshold is deliberately pending**, to be justified from baseline variance, student transfer and GPU cost before fits. Success: a practically useful paired endpoint gain with acceptable fold/seed behavior and relevant downstream transfer. Uncertainty: an unresolved effect or heterogeneous regimes can justify a bounded targeted follow-up. Negative result: no useful gain or a concrete failure mode narrows this recipe; an interval crossing0 does not close the whole direction. Record whether the result changes teacher, student or target-link allocation. +  "body": "# [Experiment] E-KALMAN-LOCAL-TREND-B300-20261018: causal smoother GRU teachers and distillation\n\n## 1. Status, lineage and owner\n\nThis is an implementation and profile-preparation draft, not a completed experiment. It adds a differentiable local-trend feature module, matched EMA and zero-feature raw arms, a strict-FP32 adapter to the canonical modular trainer, adapter-aware prediction reconstruction, and adapter/provenance checks in the existing distillation-cache builder. The source base is `research-team`; the branch and final commit are recorded by the PR. Hypothesis `H-KALMAN-LOCAL-TREND-20261018`; experiment `E-KALMAN-LOCAL-TREND-B300-20261018`. No B300 profile, PyTorch smoke, task fit, student cache, task grade or performance claim has been produced. A separate NumPy synthetic receipt is preserved and labeled as such.\n\nUpdated local discovery evidence (fixed-input replay, not B300 training): the expanded panel covers 141 previously exposed F0 groups and 82 source components, after the initial 16-group screen showed +0.000338 WP. On the wider panel, raw scored 0.72188269 WP and local-trend input replacement scored 0.72199901 WP (delta +0.00011632; paired component-bootstrap 95% interval [\u22120.00007495, +0.00028789]). This is one raw-input-trained checkpoint with four inputs replaced only at inference on the same exposed fold; the wider follow-up was selected after seeing the first point. It is therefore an attenuated, uncertain discovery result with a train/inference representation mismatch, not evidence for a trained feature, student transfer, online updates, or public transfer. The retained-raw teacher/student path proposed here remains unrun.\n\nCheckpoint loading is strict for both paths: the Kalman adapter is reconstructed\nfrom checkpoint metadata and its state dict, while standard family teachers\nload their saved state dict into the canonical model before prediction export.\nThis is required for valid teacher caches; shape and finiteness checks alone\ncannot detect random initialized predictions.\n\nFor adapted checkpoints, provenance binds the hashes of both\n`src/wnn/kalman_local_trend.py` and `src/wnn/nn.py`. Prediction export checks\nthe current implementation against those training hashes before inference;\nthe sidecar records current hashes and the prediction-driver hash. Cache\nconstruction independently checks the current files against both checkpoint\nprovenance and prediction sidecar before it accepts the teacher.\n\n## 2. Why it should work\n\nA local-linear-trend filter can expose a causal estimate of level, slope and innovation uncertainty to the GRU, providing a compact inductive bias for changing latent regimes. The strongest alternative is that ordinary smoothing or the extra input projection explains any change. For both the four-channel local pilot and full 112-channel scope, the primary control is an EMA whose gain is the fixed scalar random-walk Kalman steady-state gain; the fixed-Q/R local-trend arm separates trend-state structure from learned Q/R. A scope-matched raw arm appends zeros so each four-arm set has the same GRU width and projection shape. The learned filter uses positive scalar Q/R parameters tied by state family across selected channels. All arms retain the original raw input.\n\n## 3. Compute advantage and scaling path\n\nThe competition payoff is through a better fixed-size GRU student, not a\nteacher-only score: a Kalman teacher must improve the matched four-family\nstudent-cache endpoint, then retain a useful quality/runtime/package-size\ntradeoff in the final served pipeline.\n\nThe filter adds four features per selected raw channel and a small number of learned scalars, but its eager Python time loop may erase that nominal arithmetic advantage. The 112-channel case adds 448 inputs to the H1024 projection and may be activation-memory intensive. An actual B300 profile at the full planned shape must precede scientific fitting; no time estimate is supplied. Each arm uses fresh H1024\u00d72 weights in this primary attribution experiment. A clean-parent strong-model continuation is a separate future factor: compare it against a matched fresh model and preserve identical parent ancestry across feature treatments before claiming a continuation benefit. If the teacher has value, the included path replaces one clean same-fold teacher family in the existing four-family student cache. Larger GRU teachers, teacher-only/student-only/combined feature placement, and distillation at larger context are later scaling experiments. Teacher DDP is not implemented or required for the independent small-GRU cells.\n\n## 4. Frozen comparison\n\nThe task target is the original two competition outputs under the canonical WMSE training objective; there is no next-input reconstruction target. Direct teachers use fresh H1024\u00d72 GRUs, batch 16, chunk 2,000, AdamW at 0.001, weight decay 0.01, gradient clipping 1, two epochs, OneCycle over the exact update budget, and fixed checkpoint `model_ep1`. Students use fresh H256\u00d72 GRUs, the existing two-epoch fixed-`model_ep1` cache recipe, and `--distill-alpha 0.5`. Use canonical fit-only global normalization, identical sampler/order semantics within paired cells, and sequence state reset at each source-qualified sequence while carrying state over chunks. FP32 is required for weights, inputs, recurrent/filter states, loss, gradients and optimizer; AMP, GradScaler and CUDA TF32 are disabled. The official metric may use FP64 accumulators. No per-sequence or future-row transform is added. The code and exact commands are in [recipe.json](https://github.com/VladKochetov007/WunderFunder/blob/experiment/kalman-teacher-gru-distill-b300/research/experiment_drafts/kalman_teacher_gru_distill_b300/recipe.json).\n\n## 5. Thirty paired runs\n\nEvery arm uses the same 30 exposed fold/seed cells: F0/F1 with seeds 1001\u20131008 and F2/F3 with seeds 1001\u20131007, for 8/8/7/7 cells. The direct teacher matrix is raw-zero-pad, steady-state EMA, fixed local trend and learned local trend at `pilot4` and `all112`; this is eight arms. The student matrix has a matched existing-cache control plus pilot4-Kalman and all112-Kalman source-replacement arms; this is three more arms. Total: 11 arms, 330 scientific fits, scheduled as 42 waves of up to eight independent fits. Launch one fit per GPU; no DDP command is supported. The same seed identities pair arms within each fold. All four folds have prior exposure; this is robustness evidence, not a pristine holdout. `pilot4` is the local screening scope, while `all112` is the expanded channel-scope comparison. Profile the all112 learned arm before fit admission; if the profile passes, run both predeclared matrices in full. Pilot quality does not gate all112 inclusion.\n\n## 6. Validation and significance\n\nFor seed variability, use NumPy PCG64 seed `20261018` for 10,000\npercentile-bootstrap replicates: draw eight seed identities with replacement\nfrom 1001\u20131008, apply the same multiplicities in every fold, renormalize over\neach fold's available seeds, and redraw if any fold has zero available\nmultiplicity. For evaluation-unit variability, use separate PCG64 seed\n`20261019` for 10,000 paired source-component bootstrap replicates within each\nfold, sharing component multiplicities across arms and seed cells. Report the\ntwo marginal 95% intervals separately; both condition on the exposed folds and\nfixed fitted endpoints.\n\nGrade with unchanged `global_wp_clip2_v1`, fixed scored rows and its original clipping and weighting. Primary contrasts are learned versus EMA and learned versus fixed local trend separately for both scopes (four tests). Secondary contrasts are learned versus same-scope raw-zero-pad control and each Kalman-family student versus the shared matched-cache student (four tests). If all are reported, apply Holm correction across all eight. Use the equal-fold mean of paired seed means, a 10,000-replicate crossed seed-identity bootstrap with shared seed multiplicities across folds, and a separate 10,000-replicate paired source-component bootstrap within each fold. Report fold and seed variation separately; intervals condition on exposed folds and fitted endpoints. Profiles, synthetic checks and PyTorch parity checks are engineering evidence, not quality comparisons.\n\n## 7. Leakage and coverage\n\nThe canonical raw/event input width is 211; the adapter rejects alternative feature assembly. The four pilot channels `[0,3,52,55]` are anonymous indices and carry no physical interpretation; pilot-only findings do not extrapolate to 112 channels. The `all112` scope is explicitly separate. All features are causal and state resets by sequence. Canonical input normalization is fitted from the exact training-view loader and reused from checkpoint statistics at inference. No targets enter feature construction. Before cache building, freeze the four teacher family run IDs, epochs, split hashes, coefficients and checkpoint hashes per cell. The existing builder checks clean-fold fit membership, prediction sidecars, row ordering and checkpoint bytes. For treatment caches only `samefold_baseline` is replaced, at its unchanged coefficient. Shared ancestors are not independent replications. Previously exposed folds remain exposed.\n\n## 8. Decision-changing result\n\nA mean gain around `+0.0005` weighted Pearson is a provisional reference for prioritizing a follow-up, not a kill threshold. A useful result also needs compatible behavior across folds and acceptable measured resource cost. A zero-crossing interval is inconclusive. Negative results apply to the tested state family, channel scope, schedule and teacher/student path, not all Kalman or smoothing mechanisms. If the local pilot differs from full112, report the interaction as channel-scope dependence rather than treating the smaller result as confirmation. Continue with a clean-parent warm-start/fresh factorial, larger teacher, or student feature placement only when the profile and evidence justify it.\n\n## 9. How to run\n\nUse the exact branch source with the compatible project environment. `WNN_PROJECT_ROOT` must be a writable project namespace containing supplied `train.parquet`/`valid.parquet`, target indexes, source-qualified fold manifests, run outputs and caches. Mount the code checkout read-only at the exact source SHA. Place cache, predictions, logs and checkpoints on physical worker storage, not `/tmp` or `/dev/shm`. Run the full112 H1024 profile gate on the actual eight-B300 host and record driver/runtime versions, host/GPU peak memory, finite optimizer-update latency, filter/GRU forward-backward throughput and input overhead. If resized, freeze the new dimensions/batch and reprofile every direct arm at both scopes before admission. The packet has a synthetic smoke command, teacher training command, prediction export commands, cache builder command and standard student command in [README](https://github.com/VladKochetov007/WunderFunder/blob/experiment/kalman-teacher-gru-distill-b300/research/experiment_drafts/kalman_teacher_gru_distill_b300/README.md) and [recipe](https://github.com/VladKochetov007/WunderFunder/blob/experiment/kalman-teacher-gru-distill-b300/research/experiment_drafts/kalman_teacher_gru_distill_b300/recipe.json). The smoke and every fit remain unrun. Use one independent process per GPU; no torchrun/DDP route is implemented. Student fits are blocked pending a clean per-cell four-family registry.\n\n## 10. Evidence to return\n\nFor each optimizer update preserve attempted/successful steps, progress, loss, LR, preclip gradient norm and clipping/nonfinite counts. Each cell must bind branch/source/config hashes, software/hardware identity, split and membership hashes, teacher ancestry, optimizer-update budget, checkpoint/prediction hashes, official score, paired deltas, phase times and peak host/GPU memory. Archive evidence and model weights separately, including file and archive SHA256 and private storage location in the run manifest. Retain every valid cell and negative/inconclusive result. The local NumPy synthetic receipt and source are included in `evidence/`; the receipt reports 841,376 KiB peak RSS, so requested support-resource verification is unconfirmed. It contains no task data, labels or task model result.\n\n## 11. Results and trace\n\nNo task cell has been admitted or run from this branch; teacher/student quality and B300 runtime are unknown. A source-only independent review initially found that the adapted-source sidecar echoed checkpoint metadata rather than validating current filter code and omitted the imported GRU core. The follow-up fix binds both source files through training provenance, prediction export and cache construction; the independent source-only review cleared that path. The [review summary](https://github.com/VladKochetov007/WunderFunder/blob/main/research/unified/reviews/KALMAN_B300_DRAFT_REVIEW_20261018_R1.md) is indexed in the main checkout. The local fixed-GRU screen is separately recorded in the [Kalman results note](https://github.com/VladKochetov007/WunderFunder/blob/main/research/campaign_2026-10-18/online_features_r1/kalman_filter_probe/RESULTS_R2.md) and does not establish trained-feature value.\n\nThe three source records are [Backprop KF](https://arxiv.org/abs/1605.07148), [KalmanNet](https://arxiv.org/abs/2107.10043) and the [AI-Aided Kalman Filters survey/tutorial](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.12289). These motivate differentiable and hybrid filtering as a direction; they do not establish a Challenge2 gain. The full112 actual B300 profile and per-cell clean teacher registry are still required before fitting. This PR is an implementation handoff, not fit authorization; no public score, leaderboard transfer, speedup or competitive result is claimed.\n\n### Related local recurrent-state screen (18 October 2026)\n\nA separate matched local screen retained raw inputs and appended 39 causal groupwise fast/slow Kalman innovation-energy states. The active arm scored **0.67986413 WP**, versus **0.67981250** for an equal-width zero-state control (delta **+0.00005163**). A paired bootstrap over 141 exposed F0 components gave conditional 95% interval **[-0.00013143, +0.00027018]**; position-bin effects were mixed. Both arms used the same trained parent, 32-component fitting subset, seed/order, normalization, and 210 FP32 updates. This is one exposed fold and one incremental fine-tune, not a seed/fold replication, clean validation result, student-cache result, or evidence of long-horizon online adaptation.\n\nThis is adjacent evidence for the broader retained-raw Kalman feature question, not a replication or ranking of the local-trend teacher/student arms described above. The local packet and receipts are currently in the main worktree at `research/campaign_2026-10-18/online_features_r1/kalman_recurrent_groupfast_slow_r1/`; they are not attached to this PR branch. No separate B300 draft is justified by this near-zero result.\n",

+  "body": "# [Experiment] GRU / causal Transformer / Mamba-2: published source and CP30 handoff\n\n1. **Status, lineage and owner.** Source-preservation and integration proposal, E-ARCHITECTURE-CP30-HANDOFF-20261018; H-CAUSAL-TRANSFORMER-20261017, H-CONTEXT-TRANSFORMER-20261017 and H-SELECTIVE-SSM-20261017. The prepared implementation exists at `bd78ac1048fe9d6534e76cde8c6f8ec0d6aa6acb` on `codex/transformer-mamba-gpu-wave`. It uses an older trainer and an unrun single-F0/seed3/one-epoch screen. This PR adds a current-base handoff, not an automatic merge of that trainer or a claim of executed experiments. Receiving run owner and current executable source are unbound; launch_ready=false and training_authorized=false.\n\n2. **Why it should work.** At the same label objective, attention may retain useful selected history beyond the GRU state; extending its window tests whether additional past context matters. Mamba-2 tests selective state-space recurrence. These are candidate mechanisms, not evidence of a win. Architecture dimensions, parameter counts, optimization behavior and compute differ; a quality difference does not uniquely identify memory as the cause. C\u2212B isolates the declared window change; B\u2212A and D\u2212A compare complete model families under a common declared recipe.\n\n3. **Compute advantage.** More GPUs buy independent paired cells and, separately, larger teachers or longer training. This comparison spends on full-data repetitions before selecting a family. No scaling law, B300 throughput or public-score forecast is asserted. Report both equal-exposure endpoints and actual GPU time/memory; a compute-matched comparison would require its own frozen budget and endpoints. A teacher improvement requires a later matched compact-GRU KD test, not a promised student gain.\n\n4. **Frozen comparison.** Proposed A=GRU256\u00d72; B=causal Transformer256\u00d74/8heads/FFN4/window256; C=same/window2048; D=Mamba-2 width256/layers4/state64/head64/expand2/conv4/chunk256. Same complete source-qualified fitting membership, 211 inputs, labels-only objective, cold seeded initialization policy, row order, normalization membership, loss weights, optimizer/update schedule and fixed final checkpoint. Match paired initialization only where shapes permit; different model shapes cannot have identical tensors. Freeze six full epochs, fixed epoch5, no best-validation selection. Exact common optimizer/LR/clip/batch/update budget and stable attention/SSM implementations remain binding gates; do not claim the old one-epoch runner already implements this plan. Strict FP32 weights/states/activations/gradients/optimizer; autocast/GradScaler/TF32 off. The legacy wave only requested FP32; its TF32-off path is unverified. Current adapters must enforce and record actual precision. Reset all model/feature/cache state per sequence and serialize complete architecture state for exact resume, or restart under a new attempt ID.\n\n5. **Thirty paired runs.** F0/F1 seeds1001\u20131008 and F2/F3 seeds1001\u20131007, 30 cells for each of A/B/C/D, **120 fits total**. Three preregistered contrasts B\u2212A, C\u2212B and D\u2212A. Original F0/seed3 screen and engineering profiles do not count. All folds are exposed. Bind data/split hashes, fit-only normalization and ancestry per cell; no production train+valid checkpoint may be relabeled as a clean held-out parent.\n\n6. **Validation and significance.** Unchanged global_wp_clip2_v1 and official masks. For each contrast compute D=mean_f(mean_s(per-fit paired WP delta)), with four equal fold weights. Reuse the workflow's 10000 shared-seed bootstrap draws and separate paired component resampling, RNG20261018; eight seed identities are not 30 IID holdouts. Report marginal95% and Bonferroni98.3333% intervals for the three-contrast family, all fold means, costs, failures and exclusions. These are approximate conditional intervals, not a guarantee of power, new-regime coverage or calibrated significance. A seed ensemble or blend is a different endpoint and cannot replace the declared contrast.\n\n7. **Leakage and coverage.** Past/current supplied features only; no future label/target inputs, bidirectional attention or cross-sequence state. Sliding-window cache, Mamba recurrent state and input transforms must pass suffix/prefix/reset/chunk invariance checks on the receiving GPU. Fold-clean normalizers and complete connected-component exclusion remain mandatory. No ranking by public leaderboard feedback. Compare any later promising endpoint against a source-qualified strong baseline; the production TL3 ensemble is not a clean F0 control.\n\n8. **Decision-changing result.** Proposed useful threshold D\u2265+0.0005 WP per primary contrast, with compatible family-adjusted seed/component intervals and fold robustness; this is an allocation criterion, not a predicted effect. Report cost before deciding whether the gain merits a downstream KD comparison. No speed/CPU claim follows. Inconclusive intervals may justify bounded precision follow-up; a negative result narrows the declared model/context/optimizer budget. No dependency or profile failure is a scientific rejection.\n\n9. **How to run.** From a complete current checkout, `python scripts/experiment_draft_plan.py research/experiment_drafts/architecture-cp30-handoff/recipe.json` prints metadata only; it was not run. There is deliberately no runnable current-base training command yet. Reuse `wnn.training` model/forward/state/input/optimizer/checkpoint/provenance seams and current per-cell infrastructure. Port only reviewed architecture modules from the frozen source, retaining current prediction safety and trainer changes. Bind Linux/CUDA environment and pinned Mamba build, data roots, output paths, actual device profile and per-cell owner before any fit. Do not execute the historical host runner as this CP30 design.\n\n10. **Evidence to return.** Exact current source and inherited module pins; data/config/split/environment identities; architecture/parameter/FLOP counts; per-cell row/update/checkpoint identity, losses, LR, preclip norms, clipping/nonfinite counts, time and peak memory; complete predictions/official grades and paired uncertainty. Return weights separately from evidence with SHA256 manifests and approved storage locations. Profile/support work must be reported separately from scientific fits; failed cells never become zero scores or silent exclusions.\n\n11. **Results and trace.** No model or performance result. The old source branches were successfully pushed and their remote tips verified; independent source review found the legacy integration and precision gaps described above. Tests, model imports, training, inference and profiles were not run locally. The published source map below also preserves complete causal-smoothing code on its own branch without force-updating PR #9. No CPU endpoint or competition upload is supplied.\n\nSource map: [published GPU packets](https://github.com/VladKochetov007/WunderFunder/blob/research-team/research/unified/ideas/PUBLISHED_GPU_PACKETS_20261018.md). Historical implementation: [exact source](https://github.com/VladKochetov007/WunderFunder/tree/bd78ac1048fe9d6534e76cde8c6f8ec0d6aa6acb). Current integration contract: [training components](https://github.com/VladKochetov007/WunderFunder/blob/research-team/src/wnn/training/README.md).\n",
