+  "body": "# [Experiment] GRU / causal Transformer / Mamba-2: published source and CP30 handoff\n\n1. **Status, lineage and owner.** Source-preservation and integration proposal, E-ARCHITECTURE-CP30-HANDOFF-20261018; H-CAUSAL-TRANSFORMER-20261017, H-CONTEXT-TRANSFORMER-20261017 and H-SELECTIVE-SSM-20261017. The prepared implementation exists at `bd78ac1048fe9d6534e76cde8c6f8ec0d6aa6acb` on `codex/transformer-mamba-gpu-wave`. It uses an older trainer and an unrun single-F0/seed3/one-epoch screen. This PR adds a current-base handoff, not an automatic merge of that trainer or a claim of executed experiments. Receiving run owner and current executable source are unbound; launch_ready=false and training_authorized=false.\n\n2. **Why it should work.** At the same label objective, attention may retain useful selected history beyond the GRU state; extending its window tests whether additional past context matters. Mamba-2 tests selective state-space recurrence. These are candidate mechanisms, not evidence of a win. Architecture dimensions, parameter counts, optimization behavior and compute differ; a quality difference does not uniquely identify memory as the cause. C\u2212B isolates the declared window change; B\u2212A and D\u2212A compare complete model families under a common declared recipe.\n\n3. **Compute advantage.** More GPUs buy independent paired cells and, separately, larger teachers or longer training. This comparison spends on full-data repetitions before selecting a family. No scaling law, B300 throughput or public-score forecast is asserted. Report both equal-exposure endpoints and actual GPU time/memory; a compute-matched comparison would require its own frozen budget and endpoints. A teacher improvement requires a later matched compact-GRU KD test, not a promised student gain.\n\n4. **Frozen comparison.** Proposed A=GRU256\u00d72; B=causal Transformer256\u00d74/8heads/FFN4/window256; C=same/window2048; D=Mamba-2 width256/layers4/state64/head64/expand2/conv4/chunk256. Same complete source-qualified fitting membership, 211 inputs, labels-only objective, cold seeded initialization policy, row order, normalization membership, loss weights, optimizer/update schedule and fixed final checkpoint. Match paired initialization only where shapes permit; different model shapes cannot have identical tensors. Freeze six full epochs, fixed epoch5, no best-validation selection. Exact common optimizer/LR/clip/batch/update budget and stable attention/SSM implementations remain binding gates; do not claim the old one-epoch runner already implements this plan. Strict FP32 weights/states/activations/gradients/optimizer; autocast/GradScaler/TF32 off. The legacy wave only requested FP32; its TF32-off path is unverified. Current adapters must enforce and record actual precision. Reset all model/feature/cache state per sequence and serialize complete architecture state for exact resume, or restart under a new attempt ID.\n\n5. **Thirty paired runs.** F0/F1 seeds1001\u20131008 and F2/F3 seeds1001\u20131007, 30 cells for each of A/B/C/D, **120 fits total**. Three preregistered contrasts B\u2212A, C\u2212B and D\u2212A. Original F0/seed3 screen and engineering profiles do not count. All folds are exposed. Bind data/split hashes, fit-only normalization and ancestry per cell; no production train+valid checkpoint may be relabeled as a clean held-out parent.\n\n6. **Validation and significance.** Unchanged global_wp_clip2_v1 and official masks. For each contrast compute D=mean_f(mean_s(per-fit paired WP delta)), with four equal fold weights. Reuse the workflow's 10000 shared-seed bootstrap draws and separate paired component resampling, RNG20261018; eight seed identities are not 30 IID holdouts. Report marginal95% and Bonferroni98.3333% intervals for the three-contrast family, all fold means, costs, failures and exclusions. These are approximate conditional intervals, not a guarantee of power, new-regime coverage or calibrated significance. A seed ensemble or blend is a different endpoint and cannot replace the declared contrast.\n\n7. **Leakage and coverage.** Past/current supplied features only; no future label/target inputs, bidirectional attention or cross-sequence state. Sliding-window cache, Mamba recurrent state and input transforms must pass suffix/prefix/reset/chunk invariance checks on the receiving GPU. Fold-clean normalizers and complete connected-component exclusion remain mandatory. No ranking by public leaderboard feedback. Compare any later promising endpoint against a source-qualified strong baseline; the production TL3 ensemble is not a clean F0 control.\n\n8. **Decision-changing result.** Proposed useful threshold D\u2265+0.0005 WP per primary contrast, with compatible family-adjusted seed/component intervals and fold robustness; this is an allocation criterion, not a predicted effect. Report cost before deciding whether the gain merits a downstream KD comparison. No speed/CPU claim follows. Inconclusive intervals may justify bounded precision follow-up; a negative result narrows the declared model/context/optimizer budget. No dependency or profile failure is a scientific rejection.\n\n9. **How to run.** From a complete current checkout, `python scripts/experiment_draft_plan.py research/experiment_drafts/architecture-cp30-handoff/recipe.json` prints metadata only; it was not run. There is deliberately no runnable current-base training command yet. Reuse `wnn.training` model/forward/state/input/optimizer/checkpoint/provenance seams and current per-cell infrastructure. Port only reviewed architecture modules from the frozen source, retaining current prediction safety and trainer changes. Bind Linux/CUDA environment and pinned Mamba build, data roots, output paths, actual device profile and per-cell owner before any fit. Do not execute the historical host runner as this CP30 design.\n\n10. **Evidence to return.** Exact current source and inherited module pins; data/config/split/environment identities; architecture/parameter/FLOP counts; per-cell row/update/checkpoint identity, losses, LR, preclip norms, clipping/nonfinite counts, time and peak memory; complete predictions/official grades and paired uncertainty. Return weights separately from evidence with SHA256 manifests and approved storage locations. Profile/support work must be reported separately from scientific fits; failed cells never become zero scores or silent exclusions.\n\n11. **Results and trace.** No model or performance result. The old source branches were successfully pushed and their remote tips verified; independent source review found the legacy integration and precision gaps described above. Tests, model imports, training, inference and profiles were not run locally. The published source map below also preserves complete causal-smoothing code on its own branch without force-updating PR #9. No CPU endpoint or competition upload is supplied.\n\nSource map: [published GPU packets](https://github.com/VladKochetov007/WunderFunder/blob/research-team/research/unified/ideas/PUBLISHED_GPU_PACKETS_20261018.md). Historical implementation: [exact source](https://github.com/VladKochetov007/WunderFunder/tree/bd78ac1048fe9d6534e76cde8c6f8ec0d6aa6acb). Current integration contract: [training components](https://github.com/VladKochetov007/WunderFunder/blob/research-team/src/wnn/training/README.md).\n",

+  "body": "# [Experiment] field-age: Per-field ages versus seven group clocks\n\n1. **Status, lineage and ownership**\n\n   Implementation handoff / proposed comparison, not a fitted result. Lineage: **student/connection**. IDs: `H-DRAFT-FIELD-AGE-20261017`, `E-DRAFT-FIELD-AGE-20261017-R1`. Author/source: team repository plus this October17 draft, based on main/research-team `18407ecfa3b02d4db70cfb3c34abbacd6653e79d`. Receiving researcher owns device adaptation, source-clean bindings, profiling and complete run/evaluation return. New code in this PR: none; reuse linked existing implementation, preserving original source.\n\n2. **Why it should work**\n\n   Distinct field staleness may matter beyond a shared group clock. Expect gains concentrated in independently changing fields; compare F versus G with equal-width controls. The strongest general alternative is extra capacity, changed optimization or target calibration rather than the proposed mechanism; freeze the indicated matched controls. Current source evidence: F only profiled50 updates; C/G fitted. G-C +0.00002956, conditional interval crosses0.\n\n3. **Where more compute buys quality**\n\n   More compute buys complete fitting horizons, the30 paired cells, clean teacher cohorts and explicit capacity/context ladders; there is no measured scaling law. For student mechanisms use a single card per fit when it fits, and compare downstream official student/blend quality rather than teacher score alone. Large Transformer teachers can use multiple cards and207M/682M starting branches, with1.65B/long-context extensions conditional on evidence and memory. Do not assume all8 cards accelerate a small GRU. No leaderboard impact is measured or numerically predicted.\n\n4. **Frozen comparison and training proposal**\n\n   Arms: `group-age-G`, `field-age-F`. All use FP32 parameters, activations, states, gradients and optimizer state; autocast and TF32 off, no quantization. The adjacent recipe records **starting proposals**, not a final frozen training command: AdamW, preclip norm1,12-epoch WSD with2% warmup and20% cooldown to0.1\u00d7LR. Proposed peak LR is 0.001, with parameter-group decay exclusions for biases/norms/gates to be recorded. Exact batch/accumulation/context, source-matched targets, inner checkpoint policy and successful-update count must be bound before fits. Changing the historical FP16/two-epoch recipe to this route is an explicit successor, not a faithful rerun. Scale/context/horizon sweeps are separate frozen arms, not post-result tuning hidden within these30 cells.\n\n5. **Thirty paired runs**\n\n   Each scientific arm uses F0/F1 seeds1001\u20131008 and F2/F3 seeds1001\u20131007:30 fits per arm. Candidate/control share cells and membership. Source-clean ancestors, normalizers and cache hashes must be bound independently for every fold; old F0 parents cannot simply be reused across folds. No runs in this matrix have started. `60` fits are required for all named arms; this is a plan, not a compute allocation.\n\n6. **Validation and statistical significance**\n\n   Official `global_wp_clip2_v1`, unchanged \u00b12 evaluation clipping and original clipped-label magnitude weights. Primary statistic: one quarter times each fold's mean paired endpoint WP delta, then summed; compute scores per fit, not from seed-averaged predictions. Use the [workflow's seed/component procedures](https://github.com/VladKochetov007/WunderFunder/blob/experiment/field-age/research/unified/methods/EXPERIMENT_DRAFT_WORKFLOW_20261017_R1.md),10000 resamples, RNG17017. Separate conditional component uncertainty, fitting-seed variability, observed-fold sensitivity and unknown public transfer. Specify primary contrasts/multiplicity (Holm within frozen primary contrast family) before results. Thirty cells do not ensure power; do not treat rows, overlapping fits or four folds as many independent markets. All existing folds are exposed.\n\n7. **Future leakage and representative validation**\n\n   Inputs/feature transforms must be causal with sequence reset and fitting-only scaling. Audit source-qualified component overlap, aliases and teacher/initializer/preprocessing ancestry. True competition labels may reference future horizons; AR feedback accepts only own predictions. Check prefix invariance, reset/reload and intended chunk semantics before expensive runs. Report by source, fold, target, sequence position and activity/target-magnitude regimes; unknown anonymous clocks limit forward-market claims. No clean-validation claim is made for reused fitted groups.\n\n8. **Decision-changing outcome**\n\n   **Useful-effect threshold is deliberately pending**, to be justified from baseline variance, student transfer and GPU cost before fits. Success: a practically useful paired endpoint gain with acceptable fold/seed behavior and relevant downstream transfer. Uncertainty: an unresolved effect or heterogeneous regimes can justify a bounded targeted follow-up. +#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Freeze one nested, component-complete E540 fitting subset."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import hashlib
+import json
+import math
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+
+from wnn.splits import load_campaign_split
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+
+
+def build_manifest(
+    split_manifest: Path,
+    fraction: float | None,
+    seed: int,
+    root: Path,
+    *,
+    component_count: int | None = None,
+    experiment_id: str = "E540",
+) -> dict[str, object]:
+    """Select nested whole components without reading targets or evaluation labels."""
+    if (fraction is None) == (component_count is None):
+        raise ValueError("supply exactly one of fraction or component_count")
+    if not experiment_id or experiment_id.strip() != experiment_id:
+        raise ValueError("experiment_id must be a non-empty, trimmed string")
+    if fraction is not None and (not math.isfinite(fraction) or not 0 < fraction <= 1):
+        raise ValueError("fraction must be finite and in (0,1]")
+    if component_count is not None and (
+        isinstance(component_count, bool)
+        or not isinstance(component_count, int)
+        or component_count <= 0
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("component_count must be a positive integer")
+    campaign = load_campaign_split(split_manifest, root)
+    allowed = {
+        "train": set(campaign.train_groups),
+        "valid": set(campaign.valid_groups),
+    }
+    component_members: dict[int, list[tuple[str, int]]] = {}
+    component_of: dict[tuple[str, int], int] = {}
+    for split, group, component in campaign.components:
+        member = (split, group)
+        component_of[member] = component
+        if group in allowed[split]:
+            component_members.setdefault(component, []).append(member)
+    expected_members = {(split, group) for split, groups in allowed.items() for group in groups}
+    if set(component_of).intersection(expected_members) != expected_members:
+        raise ValueError("campaign manifest omits a fitting group component identity")
+    evaluation_components = {component_of[("valid", group)] for group in campaign.evaluation_groups}
+    eligible_components = sorted(component_members)
+    if set(eligible_components).intersection(evaluation_components):
+        raise ValueError("campaign fitting and evaluation components overlap")
+    if component_count is not None and component_count > len(eligible_components):
+        raise ValueError("component_count exceeds eligible fitting components")
+    count = (
+        component_count
+        if component_count is not None
+        else max(1, math.ceil(len(eligible_components) * fraction))
+    )
+    order = np.random.default_rng(seed).permutation(eligible_components)
+    selected_components = sorted(int(value) for value in order[:count])
+    selected = {
+        split: sorted(
+            group
+            for component in selected_components
+            for member_split, group in component_members[component]
+            if member_split == split
+        )
+        for split in ("train", "valid")
+    }
+    if not selected["train"] or not selected["valid"]:
+        raise ValueError("selected component subset must include train and valid fitting groups")
+    selected_members = sorted(
+        (split, group) for split, groups in selected.items() for group in groups
+    )
+    member_bytes = json.dumps(selected_members, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=True).encode(
+        "ascii"
+    )
+    component_bytes = np.asarray(selected_components, dtype="<i8").tobytes()
+    if not selected_members:
+        raise ValueError("component selection produced no fitting groups")
+    return {
+        "version": 1,
+        "experiment_id": experiment_id,
+        "split_manifest_sha256": campaign.sha256,
+        "selection_seed": seed,
+        "target_component_fraction": count / len(eligible_components),
+        "selection_rule": (
+            "seeded permutation of sorted eligible components; exact component count"
+            if component_count is not None
+            else "seeded permutation of sorted eligible components; ceil fraction; nested by seed"
+        ),
+        "eligible_component_count": len(eligible_components),
+        "selected_component_count": len(selected_components),
+        "selected_components": selected_components,
+        "selected_component_sha256": hashlib.sha256(component_bytes).hexdigest(),
+        "eligible_group_counts": {key: len(value) for key, value in allowed.items()},
+        "selected_groups": selected,
+        "selected_group_counts": {key: len(value) for key, value in selected.items()},
+        "selected_group_sha256": {
+            split: hashlib.sha256(np.asarray(groups, dtype="<i8").tobytes()).hexdigest()
+            for split, groups in selected.items()
+        },
+        "selected_members_sha256": hashlib.sha256(member_bytes).hexdigest(),
+        "evaluation_groups": sorted(campaign.evaluation_groups),
+        "evaluation_group_count": len(campaign.evaluation_groups),
+        "evaluation_membership_sha256": hashlib.sha256(
+            np.asarray(sorted(campaign.evaluation_groups), dtype="<i8").tobytes()
+        ).hexdigest(),
+    }
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--split-manifest", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--fraction", type=float, default=0.1)
+    parser.add_argument("--components", type=int, default=None)
+    parser.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=540)
+    parser.add_argument("--root", type=Path, default=ROOT)
+    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--experiment-id", default="E540")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    result = build_manifest(
+        args.split_manifest,
+        None if args.components is not None else args.fraction,
+        args.seed,
+        args.root,
+        component_count=args.components,
+        experiment_id=args.experiment_id,
+    )
+    args.output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    temporary = args.output.with_name(args.output.name + ".tmp")
+    with temporary.open("x", encoding="utf-8") as destination:
+        json.dump(result, destination, sort_keys=True, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
+        destination.write("\n")
+        destination.flush()
+    temporary.replace(args.output)
+    print(
+        json.dumps(
+            {
+                key: result[key]
+                for key in (
+                    "selected_component_count",
+                    "selected_group_counts",
+                    "selected_members_sha256",
+                )
+            },
+            sort_keys=True,
+        )
+    )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+"""Independent checks for causal per-field and broadcast group-age features."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import numpy as np
+
+from wnn.research_features import (
+    FIELD_AGE_CAP,
+    RAW_FIELD_GROUPS,
+    StreamingFieldAgeFeatures,
+    StreamingResearchFeatures,
+    research_features_numpy,
+)
+
+
+def _oracle(raw: np.ndarray, *, grouped: bool) -> np.ndarray:
+    """Small, deliberately row-wise specification independent of production code."""
+    result = np.zeros(raw.shape, dtype=np.float32)
+    ages = np.zeros(112, dtype=np.int64)
+    previous: np.ndarray | None = None
+    for row_index, row in enumerate(raw):
+        if previous is not None:
+            if grouped:
+                for start, end in RAW_FIELD_GROUPS:
+                    if np.any(row[start:end] != previous[start:end]):
+                        ages[start:end] = 0
+                    else:
+                        ages[start:end] = np.minimum(ages[start:end] + 1, FIELD_AGE_CAP)
+            else:
+                for column in range(112):
+                    if row[column] != previous[column]:
+                        ages[column] = 0
+                    else:
+                        ages[column] = min(ages[column] + 1, FIELD_AGE_CAP)
+        result[row_index] = np.log1p(ages.astype(np.float32))
+        previous = row.copy()
+    return result
+
+
+def _raw_panel(batch: int = 2, rows: int = 257) -> np.ndarray:
+    row = np.arange(rows, dtype=np.float32)[:, None]
+    col = np.arange(112, dtype=np.float32)[None, :]
+    values = (col + 1.0) * np.ones((rows, 1), dtype=np.float32)
+    values = np.broadcast_to(values, (rows, 112)).copy()
+    # Different reset-local schedules exercise every fixed field group and
+    # ensure the field-level representation is not accidentally group-broadcast.
+    for field in range(112):
+        period = 3 + field % 17
+        values[:, field] += (row[:, 0] // period).astype(np.float32)
+    values[1::29, 0] += 0.25
+    values[7::31, 23] += 0.5
+    values[4::37, 55] += 0.75
+    values[2::41, 111] += 1.0
+    return np.stack([values, values[::-1].copy()], axis=0)[:batch]
+
+
+def test_vectorized_age_features_match_independent_row_oracle() -> None:
+    raw = _raw_panel()
+    for mode, grouped in (("field_age", False), ("group_age", True)):
+        actual = research_features_numpy(raw, mode)
+        expected = np.stack([_oracle(sequence, grouped=grouped) for sequence in raw])
+        np.testing.assert_array_equal(actual, expected)
+        assert actual.shape == raw.shape
+        assert np.isfinite(actual).all()
+        assert np.count_nonzero(actual[:, 0]) == 0
+        if grouped:
+            for start, end in RAW_FIELD_GROUPS:
+                np.testing.assert_array_equal(
+                    actual[..., start:end],
+                    np.broadcast_to(actual[..., start : start + 1], actual[..., start:end].shape),
+                )
+    field_ages = research_features_numpy(raw, "field_age")
+    group_ages = research_features_numpy(raw, "group_age")
+    assert np.any(field_ages != group_ages)
+
+
+def test_streaming_age_features_match_oracle_across_chunks_and_resets() -> None:
+    raw = _raw_panel(rows=257)
+    cuts = (1, 2, 99, 100, 128, 256, len(raw[0]))
+    for mode, grouped in (("field_age", False), ("group_age", True)):
+        for sequence in raw:
+            stream = StreamingFieldAgeFeatures(mode)
+            parts = []
+            start = 0
+            for stop in cuts:
+                parts.append(stream.update_chunk(sequence[start:stop]))
+                start = stop
+            actual = np.concatenate(parts, axis=0)
+            np.testing.assert_array_equal(actual, _oracle(sequence, grouped=grouped))
+            integrated = StreamingResearchFeatures(mode)
+            integrated_rows = np.stack([integrated.update(row) for row in sequence])
+            np.testing.assert_array_equal(integrated_rows, _oracle(sequence, grouped=grouped))
+            stream.reset()
+            reset_replay = stream.update_chunk(sequence[:2])
+            np.testing.assert_array_equal(reset_replay, _oracle(sequence[:2], grouped=grouped))
+
+
+def test_future_raw_changes_do_not_rewrite_past_ages() -> None:
+    raw = _raw_panel(rows=257)
+    changed_future = raw.copy()
+    changed_future[:, 150:, 17] += 100.0
+    for mode in ("group_age", "field_age"):
+        original = research_features_numpy(raw, mode)
+        changed = research_features_numpy(changed_future, mode)
+        np.testing.assert_array_equal(original[:, :150], changed[:, :150])
+
+
+def test_age_caps_at_declared_history_limit() -> None:
+    raw = np.zeros((FIELD_AGE_CAP + 2, 112), dtype=np.float32)
+    actual = research_features_numpy(raw, "field_age")
+    capped_ages = np.minimum(np.arange(len(raw)), FIELD_AGE_CAP).astype(np.float32)
+    expected = np.log1p(capped_ages)
+    np.testing.assert_array_equal(actual[:, 0], expected)
+    np.testing.assert_array_equal(actual[:, -1], expected)
+
+
+def test_production_torch_path_matches_oracle_and_saturates() -> None:
+    import torch
+
+    from wnn.research_features import research_features_torch
+
+    raw = _raw_panel(rows=257)
+    changed_future = raw.copy()
+    changed_future[:, 150:, 17] += 100.0
+    for mode, grouped in (("field_age", False), ("group_age", True)):
+        expected = np.stack([_oracle(sequence, grouped=grouped) for sequence in raw])
+        actual = research_features_torch(torch.from_numpy(raw), mode).numpy()
+        np.testing.assert_allclose(actual, expected, rtol=1e-7, atol=1e-6)
+        altered = research_features_torch(torch.from_numpy(changed_future), mode).numpy()
+        np.testing.assert_array_equal(actual[:, :150], altered[:, :150])
+        # A second call starts a new sequence; it must not inherit prior clocks.
+        replay = research_features_torch(torch.from_numpy(raw[:, :2]), mode).numpy()
+        np.testing.assert_array_equal(replay, actual[:, :2])
+        constant = torch.zeros((1, FIELD_AGE_CAP + 2, 112), dtype=torch.float32)
+        capped = research_features_torch(constant, mode).numpy()
+        expected_cap = np.log1p(
+            np.minimum(np.arange(FIELD_AGE_CAP + 2), FIELD_AGE_CAP).astype(np.float32)
+        )
+        np.testing.assert_allclose(capped[0, :, 0], expected_cap, rtol=1e-7, atol=1e-6)

+
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+import pytest
+
+torch = pytest.importorskip("torch")

+def _synthetic(t=500, seed=0):
+    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
+    x = rng.normal(size=(t, 112)).astype(np.float32)
+    hold = rng.random((t, 112)) < 0.7
+    hold[0] = False
+    for i in range(1, t):
+        x[i, hold[i]] = x[i - 1, hold[i]]
+    return x
+
+
+def _weights(model):
+    return {k: np.ascontiguousarray(v.detach().numpy(), np.float32) for k, v in model.state_dict().items()}
+
+
+def _batch(model, x):
+    with torch.no_grad():
+        y, _ = model(torch.cat([torch.from_numpy(x), torch.from_numpy(event_features(x))], -1)[None])
+    return y[0, :, :2].numpy()
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("fast,atol", [(False, 2e-5), (True, 5e-4)])
+def test_predictor_matches_batch_on_synthetic(fast, atol):
+    torch.manual_seed(0)
+    model = RNNModel(211, 32, 2).eval()
+    x = _synthetic()
+    p = native.Predictor(_weights(model), fast_activations=fast)
+    got = np.stack([p.step(r) for r in x])
+    np.testing.assert_allclose(got, _batch(model, x), atol=atol)
+    p.reset()
+    np.testing.assert_allclose(p.step(x[0]), got[0], atol=0)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.data
+@pytest.mark.skipif(not RUN.exists(), reason="trained checkpoint not present")
+def test_predictor_matches_trained_checkpoint_on_real_sequence():

+
+    ck = torch.load(RUN, map_location="cpu", weights_only=False)
+    a = ck["args"]
+    model = RNNModel(ck["n_in"], a["hidden"], a["layers"], 0.0).eval()
+    model.load_state_dict(ck["model"])
+    x = SequenceFile(Path(DATASETS) / "valid.parquet").read(0).features
+    want = _batch(model, x)
+    p = native.Predictor(_weights(model), fast_activations=True)
+    got = np.stack([p.step(r) for r in x])
+    assert np.abs(got - want).max() < 2e-3
+    assert np.corrcoef(got[:, 0], want[:, 0])[0, 1] > 0.99999
+
+
+def _thread_probe(code: str) -> int:
+    """Run code in a subprocess (an abort would kill pytest itself) and return its exit code."""
+    import subprocess
+    import sys
+
+    return subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-c", code], capture_output=True, timeout=120).returncode
+
+
+def test_predictor_survives_cross_thread_use():
+    code = (
+        "import threading, numpy as np, wnn_native\n"
+        "import torch\n"
+        "from wnn.nn import RNNModel\n"
+        "m = RNNModel(211, 8, 1).eval()\n"
+        "w = {k: np.ascontiguousarray(v.detach().numpy(), np.float32) for k, v in m.state_dict().items()}\n"
+        "p = wnn_native.Predictor(w)\n"
+        "out = []\n"
+        "t = threading.Thread(target=lambda: out.append(p.step(np.zeros(112, np.float32))))\n"
+        "t.start(); t.join()\n"
+        "assert len(out) == 1 and out[0].shape == (2,)\n"
+    )
+    assert _thread_probe(code) == 0
+
+
+def test_nonfinite_input_does_not_poison_state():
+    torch.manual_seed(0)
+    model = RNNModel(211, 16, 2).eval()
+    x = _synthetic(300)
+    clean = native.Predictor(_weights(model))
+    dirty = native.Predictor(_weights(model))
+    for i, r in enumerate(x):
+        a = clean.step(r)
+        bad = r.copy()
+        if i == 100:
+            bad[5] = np.nan
+        b = dirty.step(bad)
+    assert np.isfinite(b).all()
+    assert np.abs(a - b).max() < 1.0  # recovers instead of emitting a fixed fallback forever

+from __future__ import annotations

+import numpy as np

+def _rows(t=400, seed=0):
+    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
+    x = rng.normal(size=(t, 112)).astype(np.float32)
+    hold = rng.random((t, 112)) < 0.7
+    hold[0] = False
+    for i in range(1, t):
+        x[i, hold[i]] = x[i - 1, hold[i]]
+    joint = rng.random(t) < 0.3
+    for i in range(1, t):
+        if not joint[i]:
+            x[i, 0:22] = x[i - 1, 0:22]
+    return x
+
+
+def _model(hidden=24, layers=2):
+    torch.manual_seed(0)
+    m = RNNModel(112 + 99, hidden, layers).eval()
+    with torch.no_grad():
+        m.mean.normal_()
+        m.std.uniform_(0.5, 2.0)
+    return m
+
+
+def test_row_stepping_matches_batch_features_and_model():
+    x = _rows()
+    model = _model()
+    graph = StreamingGraph(model).eval()
+    with torch.no_grad():
+        feats = torch.from_numpy(event_features(x))
+        want, _ = model(torch.cat([torch.from_numpy(x), feats], -1)[None])
+        state = initial_state(model)
+        got = []
+        for row in x:
+            y, *state = graph(torch.from_numpy(row)[None], *state)
+            got.append(y[0])
+    np.testing.assert_allclose(torch.stack(got).numpy(), want[0].numpy(), atol=2e-5)
+
+
+def test_reset_state_reproduces_first_output():
+    x = _rows(10)
+    graph = StreamingGraph(_model()).eval()
+    with torch.no_grad():
+        state = initial_state(graph.model)
+        first, *state = graph(torch.from_numpy(x[0])[None], *state)
+        for row in x[1:]:
+            _, *state = graph(torch.from_numpy(row)[None], *state)
+        again, *_ = graph(torch.from_numpy(x[0])[None], *initial_state(graph.model))
+    torch.testing.assert_close(first, again)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("control", ["none", "newest"])
+def test_causal_innovation_graph_matches_batch_and_reset(control):

+        for row in x:

+            got.append(output[0])

+  "body": "# [Experiment] E-B300-R01: cold GRU width versus depth at fixed training budget\n\n1. **Status, lineage and owner.** H-B300-R01 / E-B300-R01, labels-only student capacity branch; owned by SemyonEpanov's authorized tabdata campaign. This registers an already frozen and executing experiment, not a new prospective preregistration. Sixty strict-FP32 fits are planned. This is distinct from #2: near parameter counts and fixed updates, not matched measured FLOPs. Scientific source a266b036b02e8e012c6eb31072291dad618a169d; source-tree SHA256 `f4ef9ca8450a3e76d6b6f8295259e70aec5024d3a4f3296558bb0323add74130`. No teacher or pretrained initializer.\n\n2. **Why it should work.** A deeper recurrent composition may represent temporal interactions more efficiently than width alone. Predicted observation: deep-minus-wide gains across matched seeds and folds, rather than only one favorable fold. Additional optimization difficulty or unmatched arithmetic cost are competing explanations. This experiment estimates a fixed-recipe capacity contrast; it cannot establish a general depth scaling law.\n\n3. **Compute advantage.** Eight B300s provide 30 independent paired fitting cells per arm. Four measured concurrent actors per GPU share capacity with the separate PR15 experiment. Additional compute buys replication, not an assumed leaderboard gain. Serving cost and downstream distillation require separate evidence.\n\n4. **Frozen comparison.** Wide GRU H512x1 (2,210,306 parameters) versus deep H384x2 (2,151,554); wide is 2.73% larger. Input: 112 raw plus 99 canonical event features. Fit-only two-batch normalization, labels-only loss, batch8, context/chunk2000, six complete epochs, fixed epoch5 checkpoint. AdamW lr1e-4, beta2=.999, weight decay=.01, OneCycle warmup=.05, clipping1, dropout0. Strict FP32, autocast and TF32 disabled. Same fold/seed controls, no teacher, initialization warm start or automatic scientific retries. The frozen execution manifest is `95f82d442eefe425dde6574222b037ba1deba2d3ae36534aeec41e31e450874f`.\n\n5. **Thirty paired runs.** Per arm: F0/F1 seeds1003..1010, F2/F3 seeds1003..1009, an 8/8/7/7 matrix. Seeds1001/1002 remain externally owned and excluded. Panel SHA256 `471f465cc1d13fc6e5153a4c998390bb14e06823fed4c6721f929ce95fee47fb`; all sixty cells retain distinct fit claims. Resource profiles are excluded from replication counts.\n\n6. **Validation and significance.** Unchanged `global_wp_clip2_v1`, official target mask, component-qualified evaluation. Primary statistic: equal-fold mean of matched deep-minus-wide WP. Frozen 10,000 shared-fitting-seed bootstrap replicates, RNG271828; component uncertainty is evaluated separately. These are exposed development folds; fitting-seed intervals do not quantify selection or public-transfer uncertainty. Partial tables are descriptive and are not significance tests.\n\n7. **Leakage and coverage.** Frozen fold membership, fitting-only normalization and past-only recurrent inputs apply. No labels enter feature assembly. Source-qualified sequence/component identities must match fit/export/grade manifests; cross-fold evaluation is robustness evidence, not a pristine holdout. This capacity comparison does not establish representativeness for unobserved market regimes.\n\n8. **Decision-changing result.** Frozen decision SHA256 `32a9f0aaee4a0a839468c618853ec441d65e5bce91860a5b202454e931b235d7`. A useful absolute WP difference of .001 guides follow-up spending; it is not a universal significance threshold. Assess quality alongside measured runtime and serving cost. Preserve negative and inconclusive cells; a zero-crossing interval alone does not close the lineage. No automatic model promotion or leaderboard forecast.\n\n9. **How to run.** Existing deployment only: `/data/epanov_s/tabdata`, explicit `.venv/bin/python`, immutable `runtime/b300-r01-v1` and `runtime/source-a266-lf-subset-v1`. Active controller is `tabdata-r01-density4-v1`, using `runtime/r01-density4-v1/successor.py --authority receipts/r01-density4-admission-v1/AUTHORITY.json run`. Do not repeat that command while the service owns the panel. The original controller MainPID520360 is intentionally stopped; eight existing workers were adopted without restart. The successor retains the original absolute72h deadline and12h per-fit limit. Use `systemctl --user status tabdata-r01-density4-v1` to inspect, not a new controller. Separate reporter services never fit, export, grade or retry models.\n\n10. **Evidence to return.** Source/config/environment/ancestry, per-batch losses, LR, preclip gradient norms and step counts, original fit checkpoints, export manifests, prediction banks and official grade receipts. The reporter validates immutable chains before publication and creates separate evidence/weights archives plus SHA256 manifests under `/data/epanov_s/tabdata/artifacts/github-reporting-v1/`. Private data and weights are not uploaded to GitHub. Recovered PR15 exports preserve original failed receipts and missing original timing; they are not extra fits.\n\n11. **Results and trace.** [B300 campaign](../../campaign_2026-10-18/b300_execution_r1/README.md), [controller handoff](../../campaign_2026-10-18/b300_execution_r1/density4_v1/r01_successor/README.md), [reporter and authorization](../../campaign_2026-10-18/b300_execution_r1/github_reporting_v1/README.md). Before initial reporter deployment,32 scientific fits were active:16 R01 plus16 PR15;16 original PR15 endpoints were already scored. R01 official results are published only after receipt validation. Shared infrastructure and PR15 delivery repair in this branch are supporting evidence, not new R01 treatment arms. Per-endpoint comments retain failures, hashes and archive locations. +# B300 bounded 24-slot short-screen amendment
+
+This new cohort explicitly supersedes the old CP30 launch scope for this allocation only. It does not resume the historical controllers or complete the original full-data PR26/PR27 matrices.
+
+The user authorizes all eight existing B300 devices, three owned actors per GPU, a strict four-hour node wall-time limit, partial work, and results/cleanup within that limit. Common T0 is **2026-10-22 03:02:11 UTC**; the absolute deadline is **07:02:11 UTC / 10:02:11 Moscow**. Actual systemd startup settings are captured in [the startup receipt](receipts/STARTUP_UNIT.json): RuntimeMaxSec=13500s, TimeoutStopSec=120s, KillMode=control-group, no restart, and an ExecStopPost final publisher. The two bounded stop/finalizer allowances leave the all-in service ceiling at 13740s, below 14400s. No foreign service or process is stopped.
+
+## Question and comparison
+
+PR26 tests per-field versus grouped causal ages at the same 323-input width. PR27 tests causal innovations versus the same-width moments/zeroed-innovation control, 291 inputs. Both use cold H512x1, source a266b036b02e8e012c6eb31072291dad618a169d, labels only, strict FP32, autocast and TF32 off, AdamW/OneCycle, six epochs and fixed epoch5. All incomplete endpoints remain partial and unscored under this exact endpoint.
+
+The finite panel is two mechanisms × two fitting-data fidelities × three matched fold/seed cells × two arms = **24 new scientific fit attempts**. Cells are F0/seed1201, F2/seed1202 and F3/seed1203. Fidelities select 10% and 25% of complete fitting components, nested by a label-independent SHA ordering. Actual sequence counts differ from component fractions and are explicit in [PLAN.json](packet/PLAN.json). Every sequence retains its full 20000 rows, while official held-out membership/scoring is unchanged.
+
+This is a deliberate data-fidelity comparison for two mechanisms, not four independent discoveries. There are six fits per mechanism/fidelity panel, twelve per mechanism across both fidelities. Controls are new subset-matched fits; no old full-data control or unqualified partial checkpoint is reused. The larger subset tests whether a cheap screen's direction persists with more data. It is not full-data confirmation or a public-score forecast.
+
+## Evidence and lifecycle
+
+[Packet manifest](packet/MANIFEST.json), [source](packet/code/recipe.py), [finite execution](packet/code/run_cohort.py), [fit validation](packet/code/validate_fit.py), and [publisher](packet/code/publish.py) preserve exact recipes, request hashes, input membership, source pins and deadlines. All fitting uses the existing canonical trainer and original process envelope; all scoring uses the unchanged original grader.
+
+[CPU preflight](receipts/CPU_PREFLIGHT_V2.json) checked slot counts, paired inputs, nested complete components, permitted CPUs and owned process timeout. [Independent review acceptance](receipts/SOURCE_REVIEW_ACCEPTANCE.json) records the fixed exact-arm/request validation gap; later user permission for partial work is explicit in the final plan. [All 24 profiles passed](receipts/PROFILES.json), each with100 successful updates and finite losses/gradients. [Actual admission](receipts/ADMISSION.json) admits24 fits. Profiles are engineering work, not additional scientific replications.
+
+Fit processes stop at T0+11100s, export at T0+12900s, and grading at T0+13140s. Every subprocess is owned and bounded; the outer service kills its full cgroup and invokes the final publisher even on timeout/failure. Accepted pairs publish updates as SemyonEpanov to PR26 and PR27. The final publisher records an actual owned-CUDA-client cgroup check before posting terminal results. A transport failure is retained in the private outbox/failure receipt; successful authentication and both comment writes were verified before science.
+
+Live artifacts and later terminal receipts remain at /data/epanov_s/tabdata/state/short4h-20261022-r1. The committed receipts are startup/profile evidence, not final model scores. Keep lifecycle counts separate: attempted, complete-epoch records, integrity accepted, exported and officially scored. Component bootstrap intervals condition on fixed models; three paired cells cannot separate all fold/seed effects or establish public transfer.
+
+- [PR26 live result/status comment](https://github.com/VladKochetov007/WunderFunder/pull/26#issuecomment-6331586358)
+- [PR27 live result/status comment](https://github.com/VladKochetov007/WunderFunder/pull/27#issuecomment-6331586689)
+
+All negative, partial and failed work is retained. No automatic promotion, best-checkpoint selection, quantization, extra teacher training, new rental or source-recipe retry is admitted.

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import fcntl

+

+def report(final: bool) -> dict:
+    """Publish bounded lifecycle and paired outcomes as SemyonEpanov, preserving an outbox."""
+    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "runtime/github-reporting-v1/code"))
+    from feature_common import read, sha, write
+    from github_api import GitHub, read_token
+
+    config = read(ROOT / "runtime/github-reporting-v1/CONFIG.json")
+    api = GitHub(read_token(Path(config["token_file"])), request_limit=20)
+    identity = api.request("GET", "/user")
+    if identity["login"] != "SemyonEpanov":
+        raise ValueError("Publisher is not the authorized account")
+    plan = read(PACKET / "PLAN.json")
+    own_gpu = []
+    observed = subprocess.check_output(
+        [
+            "nvidia-smi",
+            "--query-compute-apps=pid,gpu_uuid,used_gpu_memory",
+            "--format=csv,noheader",
+        ],
+        text=True,
+        timeout=10,
+    )
+    for row in observed.splitlines():
+        pid = int(row.split(",")[0])
+        try:
+            group = Path(f"/proc/{pid}/cgroup").read_text()
+        except FileNotFoundError:
+            continue
+        if "/tabdata-short4h-20261022-r1.service" in group:
+            own_gpu.append(row)
+    gpu_proof = dict(observed_unix=time.time(), owned_gpu_processes=own_gpu, final=final)
+    write(STATE / "FINAL_GPU_PROOF.json" if final else STATE / "GPU_STATUS.json", gpu_proof)
+    results = []
+    for mechanism, number in [("age", 26), ("innovation", 27)]:
+        jobs = [j for j in plan["jobs"] if j["mechanism"] == mechanism]
+        start = read(STATE / "START.json") if (STATE / "START.json").exists() else None
+        label = "Final bounded run" if final else "Bounded run status"
+        lines = [
+            f"<!-- tabdata-short4h-20261022-r1:PR{number} -->",
+            f"### {label}: 24-slot / strict four-hour node allocation",
+            "",
+            f"Plan SHA256: `{sha(PACKET / 'PLAN.json')}`. Source `a266b036b02e8e012c6eb31072291dad618a169d`.",
+            "Explicit new short-screen amendment; this does not complete or resume the historical CP30 panel.",
+            "Two mechanisms × two fitting-data fidelities × three paired fold/seed cells × two arms = 24 planned fits total, 12 relevant to this PR.",
+            "Fidelities: 10% / 25% complete fitting components (nested per fold), full 20k-row sequences, full unchanged exposed evaluation folds. Cells F0/s1201, F2/s1202, F3/s1203.",
+            "Cold H512×1, strict FP32, autocast/TF32 off, label WMSE, AdamW/OneCycle, six epochs / fixed epoch5; no validation checkpoint selection.",
+            f"GPU state: {len(own_gpu)} campaign CUDA clients at this observation. "
+            + (
+                "All campaign GPU computation is stopped."
+                if final and not own_gpu
+                else "Status is not terminal stop proof."
+            ),
+            "",
+        ]
+        if start:
+            lines.append(
+                f"Common start Unix {start['start_unix']:.3f}; absolute four-hour deadline {start['deadline_unix']:.3f}. Profiles count inside the allocation. RuntimeMaxSec=13500 / control-group stop, leaving time for publication."
+            )
+        counts = {
+            stage: sum((STATE / "work" / j["id"] / file).exists() for j in jobs)
+            for stage, file in [
+                ("fit_integrity_accepted", "FIT.json"),
+                ("exported", "EXPORTED.json"),
+                ("failed_or_cutoff", "FAILURE.json"),
+            ]
+        }
+        partial = []
+        for job in jobs:
+            h = STATE / "work" / job["id"] / "artifacts/runs" / job["id"] / "history.json"
+            try:
+                history = json.loads(h.read_text()) if h.exists() else []
+            except json.JSONDecodeError:
+                history = []
+            if not (STATE / "work" / job["id"] / "EXPORTED.json").exists():
+                partial.append(f"{job['id']}: {len(history)}/6 epoch records; partial/unscored")
+        lines += [
+            "",
+            "Lifecycle counts: `" + json.dumps(counts, sort_keys=True) + "`.",
+            "",
+            "| Data fidelity | Fold / seed | Control WP | Candidate WP | Paired delta |",
+            "|---|---|---:|---:|---:|",
+        ]
+        for gradefile in sorted((STATE / "scored").glob(mechanism + "_p*.json")):
+            r = read(gradefile)
+            lines.append(
+                f"| {r['family']} | F{r['fold']} / {r['seed']} | {r['control_wp']:.8f} | {r['candidate_wp']:.8f} | {r['candidate_wp'] - r['control_wp']:+.8f} |"
+            )
+        lines += [
+            "",
+            "All individual deltas are exploratory development evidence, not public-transfer or significance claims. Fidelity panels share cells; they are not independent discoveries. Component intervals in original grade.json condition on fitted models.",
+            "",
+            "<details><summary>Partial / unscored endpoints</summary>",
+            "",
+            *partial,
+            "",
+            "</details>",
+            "",
+            f"Artifacts, commands, epochs, source/input hashes, negatives and exact failures are preserved at `{STATE}`. No datasets, private credentials or model weights are posted.",
+        ]
+        body = "\n".join(lines)
+        outbox = STATE / f"PR{number}_LATEST.md"
+        outbox.write_text(body)
+        marker = lines[0]
+        comments = api.comments(number)
+        own = [
+            c
+            for c in comments
+            if marker in c.get("body", "") and c.get("user", {}).get("login") == "SemyonEpanov"
+        ]
+        result = api.patch(own[-1]["id"], body) if own else api.post(number, body)
+        results.append(
+            dict(
+                pr=number,
+                url=result["html_url"],
+                comment_id=result["id"],
+                final=final,
+                body_sha256=sha(outbox),
+            )
+        )
+    write(
+        STATE / "PUBLICATION_LATEST.json",
+        dict(results=results, time_unix=time.time(), final=final, gpu_proof=gpu_proof),
+    )
+    return dict(results=results, owned_gpu_clients=len(own_gpu))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("--final", action="store_true")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    with (STATE / "publication.lock").open("a") as lock:
+        fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX)
+        try:
+            print(json.dumps(report(args.final)))
+        except Exception as error:
+            from feature_common import write
+
+            write(
+                STATE / "PUBLICATION_FAILURE.json",
+                dict(error=repr(error), observed_unix=time.time()),
+            )
+            raise

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import json
+import math
+
+from bootstrap import EXPERIMENT, PACKET, ROOT, SOURCE, STATE
+from feature_common import legacy, sha, training_arguments, verify_source, write
+from feature_common import read as read
+from wnn.splits import load_campaign_split
+from wnn.training.membership import load_component_fit_subset
+
+
+def subset_manifest(fold: int, fraction: float) -> dict:
+    """Select nested, complete fitting components without accessing labels."""
+    import numpy as np
+
+    split = load_campaign_split(ROOT / "splits" / f"fold{fold}.json", ROOT / "data")
+    allowed = {"train": set(split.train_groups), "valid": set(split.valid_groups)}
+    eligible = [(s, g, c) for s, g, c in split.components if g in allowed[s]]
+    components = sorted(
+        {c for _, _, c in eligible},
+        key=lambda c: hashlib.sha256(f"4h22:{fold}:{c}".encode()).digest(),
+    )
+    chosen = set(components[: max(1, math.ceil(len(components) * fraction))])
+    groups = {s: sorted(g for ss, g, c in eligible if ss == s and c in chosen) for s in allowed}
+    members = sorted((s, g) for s in groups for g in groups[s])
+    evaluated = sorted(split.evaluation_groups)
+    value = {
+        "version": 1,
+        "experiment_id": EXPERIMENT,
+        "fold": fold,
+        "fraction_of_components": fraction,
+        "selection_seed": "sha256:4h22:fold:component",
+        "split_manifest_sha256": split.sha256,
+        "selected_groups": groups,
+        "selected_components": sorted(chosen),
+        "selected_members_sha256": hashlib.sha256(
+            json.dumps(members, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=True).encode("ascii")
+        ).hexdigest(),
+        "selected_component_sha256": hashlib.sha256(
+            np.asarray(sorted(chosen), dtype="<i8").tobytes()
+        ).hexdigest(),
+        "evaluation_groups": evaluated,
+        "evaluation_group_count": len(evaluated),
+        "evaluation_membership_sha256": hashlib.sha256(
+            np.asarray(evaluated, dtype="<i8").tobytes()
+        ).hexdigest(),
+        "evaluation_exposure": "previously exposed development components",
+    }
+    path = PACKET / "subsets" / f"f{fold}_p{round(100 * fraction)}.json"
+    write(path, value, fresh=True)
+    load_component_fit_subset(path, split, expected_experiment_id=EXPERIMENT)
+    return dict(
+        path=str(path),
+        sha256=sha(path),
+        train=len(groups["train"]),
+        valid=len(groups["valid"]),
+        components=len(chosen),
+    )
+
+
+def argv_for(job: dict, profile: bool) -> list[str]:
+    """Amend only fitting membership; retain the frozen six-epoch FP32 recipe."""
+    base = dict(job, family=job["mechanism"])
+    argv = training_arguments(ROOT, base, mode="profile" if profile else "fit")
+    argv += [
+        "--fit-subset-manifest",
+        job["subset"]["path"],
+        "--fit-subset-experiment-id",
+        EXPERIMENT,
+    ]
+    if profile:
+        for flag, value in [("--profile-steps", "8"), ("--profile-warmup", "2")]:
+            argv[argv.index(flag) + 1] = value
+        argv += ["--max-batches", "10"]
+    return argv
+
+
+def prepare() -> None:
+    """Freeze 24 fits, exact commands, dependency hashes and unchanged scoring."""
+    if (PACKET / "PLAN.json").exists():
+        raise FileExistsError("Preparation is single-use; preserve the earlier packet")
+    identity = verify_source(ROOT)
+    modules = legacy(ROOT)
+    gpus = (
+        __import__("subprocess")
+        .check_output(["nvidia-smi", "--query-gpu=uuid", "--format=csv,noheader"], text=True)
+        .splitlines()
+    )
+    assert len(gpus) == 8
+    cells = [(0, 1201), (2, 1202), (3, 1203)]
+    subsets = {(f, p): subset_manifest(f, p) for f, _ in cells for p in (0.10, 0.25)}
+    jobs = []
+    for panel, (mechanism, fraction, arms) in enumerate(
+        [
+            ("age", 0.10, ["group", "field"]),
+            ("innovation", 0.10, ["moments", "innovations"]),
+            ("age", 0.25, ["group", "field"]),
+            ("innovation", 0.25, ["moments", "innovations"]),
+        ]
+    ):
+        for cell_index, (fold, seed) in enumerate(cells):
+            for arm_index, arm in enumerate(arms):
+                index = 2 * cell_index + arm_index
+                gpu = 2 * panel + index // 3
+                name = f"short4h_{mechanism}_p{round(100 * fraction)}_{arm}_f{fold}_s{seed}"
+                work = STATE / "work" / name
+                work.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
+                inputs = modules["fit_workspace"].prepare_workspace(
+                    work, ROOT / "data", ROOT / "splits" / f"fold{fold}.json", fold
+                )
+                job = dict(
+                    id=name,
+                    mechanism=mechanism,
+                    family=f"{mechanism}_p{round(100 * fraction)}",
+                    arm=arm,
+                    fold=fold,
+                    seed=seed,
+                    fraction=fraction,
+                    gpu_index=gpu,
+                    gpu_uuid=gpus[gpu],
+                    subset=subsets[fold, fraction],
+                    slot=index % 3,
+                    cpus=[2 * (3 * gpu + index % 3), 2 * (3 * gpu + index % 3) + 1],
+                )
+                write(
+                    work / "INPUTS.json",
+                    dict(inputs, actual_fit_subset=job["subset"], source=identity),
+                    fresh=True,
+                )
+                for phase in ["profile", "fit"]:
+                    phase_work = work
+                    if phase == "profile":
+                        phase_work = STATE / "profiles" / name
+                        phase_work.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
+                        modules["fit_workspace"].prepare_workspace(
+                            phase_work, ROOT / "data", ROOT / "splits" / f"fold{fold}.json", fold
+                        )
+                    prediction = [
+                        name,
+                        "valid",
+                        "--epoch",
+                        "5",
+                        "--campaign-split-manifest",
+                        str(ROOT / "splits" / f"fold{fold}.json"),
+                        "--campaign-evaluation-only",
+                        "--device",
+                        "cuda",
+                        "--inference-precision",
+                        "fp32",
+                    ]
+                    modules["worker"]._make_request(
+                        phase_work / f"{phase}_request.json",
+                        mode="profile" if phase == "profile" else "fit",
+                        name=name,
+                        source_root=SOURCE,
+                        work=phase_work,
+                        train_argv=argv_for(job, phase == "profile"),
+                        predict_argv=prediction,
+                    )
+                job["requests"] = {
+                    str(w): sha(w)
+                    for w in [
+                        STATE / "profiles" / name / "profile_request.json",
+                        work / "fit_request.json",
+                    ]
+                }
+                jobs.append(job)
+    dependencies = {
+        str(p): sha(p) for p in (ROOT / "runtime/parallel-expansion-v1/code").glob("*.py")
+    }
+    plan = dict(
+        dependencies=dependencies,
+        schema="tabdata-short4h-plan.v1",
+        experiment=EXPERIMENT,
+        stage="prepared_not_started",
+        user_authority="22 October: 8xB300, three jobs per GPU, STRICT four hours node wall time",
+        hard_wall_seconds=14400,
+        service_runtime_max_seconds=13500,
+        service_stop_grace_seconds=120,
+        profile_budget_seconds=900,
+        grade_cutoff_seconds=13140,
+        allow_partial_under_hard_cutoff=True,
+        max_stop_and_finalizer_allowance_seconds=240,
+        all_in_service_bound_seconds=13740,
+        fit_cutoff_seconds=11100,
+        final_export_cutoff_seconds=12900,
+        cells=cells,
+        fits=24,
+        mechanism_comparisons=2,
+        fidelity_panels=4,
+        jobs=jobs,
+        source=identity,
+        endpoint="six epochs, fixed epoch5; full20k sequences; full fixed exposed evaluation; no best checkpoint",
+        measured_subset_runtime_seconds=None,
+        budget_gpu_hours_ceiling=32,
+        fidelity_caveat="10pct/25pct complete-component fractions, not full-data results; fidelity panels share cells and are not independent replications",
+        selection_policy="retain every cell; compare paired endpoint WP; no auto promotion or blanket zero-crossing rejection",
+    )
+    write(PACKET / "PLAN.json", plan, fresh=True)
+    files = {
+        str(p.relative_to(PACKET)): sha(p)
+        for p in PACKET.rglob("*")
+        if p.is_file() and "__pycache__" not in p.parts
+    }
+    write(PACKET / "MANIFEST.json", dict(files=files), fresh=True)
+    print(
+        json.dumps(
+            dict(
+                stage=plan["stage"],
+                fits=24,
+                panels=4,
+                subsets=subsets_to_list(subsets),
+                plan_sha256=sha(PACKET / "PLAN.json"),
+            )
+        )
+    )
+
+
+def subsets_to_list(subsets: dict) -> list[dict]:
+    """Report the selected data size without dumping source identities."""
+    return [dict(fold=f, fraction=p, **s) for (f, p), s in subsets.items()]
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    prepare()

+from recipe import PACKET, ROOT, SOURCE, STATE, legacy, read, sha, verify_source, write
+
+
+def check_packet() -> dict:
+    """Verify the reviewed finite cohort and every selected component manifest."""
+    for name, digest in read(PACKET / "MANIFEST.json")["files"].items():
+        if sha(PACKET / name) != digest:
+            raise ValueError("Packet changed: " + name)
+    plan = read(PACKET / "PLAN.json")
+    if plan["fits"] != 24 or plan["hard_wall_seconds"] != 14400:
+        raise ValueError("Incorrect cohort authority")
+    verify_source(ROOT)
+    for name, digest in plan["dependencies"].items():
+        if sha(Path(name)) != digest:
+            raise ValueError("Inherited helper changed: " + name)
+    for job in plan["jobs"]:
+        if sha(Path(job["subset"]["path"])) != job["subset"]["sha256"]:
+            raise ValueError("Fitting subset changed")
+        for name, digest in job["requests"].items():
+            if sha(Path(name)) != digest:
+                raise ValueError("Sealed actor request changed")
+        if job["gpu_index"] not in range(8) or not job["cpus"]:
+            raise ValueError("Incorrect hardware allocation")
+    return plan
+
+
+def run_process(
+    command: list[str], env: dict, cwd: Path, log: Path, deadline: float, cpus: list[int]
+) -> dict:
+    """Run only an owned process group and enforce the shared absolute deadline."""
+    started = time.time()
+    if started >= deadline:
+        raise TimeoutError("No time remains for this phase")
+    log.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    argv = ["taskset", "-c", ",".join(map(str, cpus)), *command]
+    with log.open("x") as output:
+        process = subprocess.Popen(
+            argv,
+            cwd=cwd,
+            env=env,
+            stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
+            stdout=output,
+            stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
+            start_new_session=True,
+        )
+        try:
+            rc = process.wait(timeout=max(0.1, deadline - time.time()))
+        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
+            os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
+            try:
+                process.wait(timeout=8)
+            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
+                os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
+                process.wait(timeout=3)
+            raise TimeoutError("Owned phase stopped at shared cutoff") from None
+    record = dict(
+        command=argv,
+        exit_code=rc,
+        started_unix=started,
+        finished_unix=time.time(),
+        elapsed_seconds=time.time() - started,
+        log_sha256=sha(log),
+    )
+    if rc != 0:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"Phase exit {rc}; see {log}")
+    return record
+
+
+def actor(job: dict, phase: str, deadline: float) -> dict:
+    """Execute the existing strict-FP32 B300 actor in its declared isolated root."""
+    work = STATE / ("profiles" if phase == "profile" else "work") / job["id"]
+    modules = legacy(ROOT)
+    inherited = modules["worker"]
+    env = inherited._phase_environment(
+        dict(os.environ), work=work, gpu_uuid=job["gpu_uuid"], phase=phase
+    )
+    package = ROOT / "runtime/pr15-host-v2"
+    name = "export_cell.py" if phase == "export" else "train_cell.py"
+    request = work / ("profile_request.json" if phase == "profile" else "fit_request.json")
+    argv = [
+        sys.executable,
+        "-B",
+        "-u",
+        str(package / "gpu_entrypoint.py"),
+        str(package / name),
+        "--request",
+        str(request),
+    ]
+    result = run_process(argv, env, SOURCE, work / "logs" / (phase + ".log"), deadline, job["cpus"])
+    envelope = work / "envelope" / phase / (Path(name).stem + "_resource_receipt.json")
+    receipt = read(envelope)
+    if receipt["status"] != "actor_returned" or receipt["visible_devices"] != job["gpu_uuid"]:
+        raise ValueError("Actor envelope identity differs")
+    result["envelope_sha256"] = sha(envelope)
+    if phase == "profile":
+        lines = (work / "logs/profile.log").read_text(errors="replace").splitlines()
+        values = [
+            json.loads(line[len("PROFILE ") :]) for line in lines if line.startswith("PROFILE ")
+        ]
+        if not values or not math.isfinite(values[-1]["step_wall"]) or values[-1]["step_wall"] <= 0:
+            raise ValueError("Missing finite representative profile timing")
+        stats = [
+            json.loads(line[len("GRAD_STATS ") :])
+            for line in lines
+            if line.startswith("GRAD_STATS ")
+        ]
+        if not stats or stats[-1]["nonfinite_steps"] != 0:
+            raise ValueError("Missing finite profile gradients")
+        result["profile"] = values[-1]
+        result["forecast_fit_seconds"] = (
+            result["elapsed_seconds"]
+            + 1.5
+            * 6
+            * ((job["subset"]["train"] + job["subset"]["valid"]) // 8)
+            * values[-1]["step_wall"]
+            / 1000
+        )
+    write(work / (phase + "_phase.json"), result, fresh=True)
+    return result
+
+
+def deliver(job: dict, start: float) -> dict:
+    """Fit once, validate the endpoint and export without reusing old science."""
+    from feature_outputs import validate_export
+    from validate_fit import validate
+
+    work = STATE / "work" / job["id"]
+    try:
+        actor(job, "fit", start + 11100)
+        fit = validate(job)
+        actor(job, "export", start + 12900)
+        prediction = validate_export(ROOT, work, job, fit["checkpoint_sha256"])
+        endpoint = dict(
+            schema="tabdata-short4h-endpoint.v1",
+            status="fit_export_completed",
+            job=job,
+            fit=fit,
+            prediction=prediction,
+            fit_receipt_sha256=sha(work / "FIT.json"),
+        )
+        write(work / "EXPORTED.json", endpoint, fresh=True)
+        return endpoint
+    except Exception as error:
+        write(
+            work / "FAILURE.json",
+            dict(error_type=type(error).__name__, error=str(error), time_unix=time.time()),
+            fresh=True,
+        )
+        raise
+
+
+def bounded_grade(candidate: dict, control: dict, start: float) -> dict:
+    """Run unchanged grading in a child group under the common phase deadline."""
+    pair_id = (
+        f"{candidate['job']['family']}_f{candidate['job']['fold']}_s{candidate['job']['seed']}"
+    )
+    env = dict(
+        os.environ,
+        CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="",
+        OMP_NUM_THREADS="2",
+        OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS="2",
+        MKL_NUM_THREADS="2",
+    )
+    command = [
+        sys.executable,
+        "-B",
+        str(PACKET / "code/run_cohort.py"),
+        "--start-unix",
+        str(start),
+        "--grade",
+        candidate["job"]["id"],
+        control["job"]["id"],
+    ]
+    run_process(
+        command,
+        env,
+        ROOT,
+        STATE / "grade_process_logs" / (pair_id + ".log"),
+        start + 13140,
+        [48, 49, 50, 51],
+    )
+    receipt = read(STATE / "grades" / pair_id / "RECEIPT.json")
+    try:
+        run_process(
+            [sys.executable, "-B", str(PACKET / "code/publish.py")],
+            env,
+            ROOT,
+            STATE / "publication_logs" / (pair_id + ".log"),
+            min(start + 13200, time.time() + 90),
+            [48, 49, 50, 51],
+        )
+    except Exception as error:
+        write(STATE / "publication_logs" / (pair_id + ".failure.json"), dict(error=repr(error)))
+    return receipt
+
+
+def execute(start: float) -> None:
+    """Own one finite 24-slot cohort; stop admission at resource or time failures."""
+    plan = check_packet()
+    write(
+        STATE / "START.json",
+        dict(
+            start_unix=start,
+            deadline_unix=start + 14400,
+            first_gpu_phase="profile",
+            service="tabdata-short4h-20261022-r1.service",
+        ),
+        fresh=True,
+    )
+    profiles, errors = {}, {}
+    with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=24) as pool:
+        pending = {pool.submit(actor, job, "profile", start + 900): job for job in plan["jobs"]}
+        for future in concurrent.futures.as_completed(pending):
+            job = pending[future]
+            try:
+                profiles[job["id"]] = future.result()
+            except Exception as error:
+                errors[job["id"]] = repr(error)
+    write(STATE / "PROFILES.json", dict(results=profiles, failures=errors), fresh=True)
+    if errors:
+        raise RuntimeError("Profile failures; no scientific fits admitted")
+    admitted, rejected = [], []
+    for i in range(0, 24, 2):
+        pair = plan["jobs"][i : i + 2]
+        if plan.get("allow_partial_under_hard_cutoff") or all(
+            time.time() + profiles[j["id"]]["forecast_fit_seconds"] < start + 10800 for j in pair
+        ):
+            admitted.extend(pair)
+        else:
+            rejected.extend(j["id"] for j in pair)
+    write(
+        STATE / "ADMISSION.json",
+        dict(
+            admitted=[j["id"] for j in admitted],
+            rejected_timing=rejected,
+            profile_results_sha256=sha(STATE / "PROFILES.json"),
+            observed_unix=time.time(),
+        ),
+        fresh=True,
+    )
+    endpoints, fit_errors, grades = {}, {}, {}
+    with (
+        concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=24) as pool,
+        concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as grading,
+    ):
+        fits = {pool.submit(deliver, job, start): job for job in admitted}
+        queued_grades = {}
+        for future in concurrent.futures.as_completed(fits):
+            job = fits[future]
+            try:
+                endpoints[job["id"]] = future.result()
+            except Exception as error:
+                fit_errors[job["id"]] = repr(error)
+            partner_jobs = [
+                j
+                for j in admitted
+                if (j["family"], j["fold"], j["seed"]) == (job["family"], job["fold"], job["seed"])
+            ]
+            pair_id = f"{job['family']}_f{job['fold']}_s{job['seed']}"
+            if (
+                len(partner_jobs) == 2
+                and all(j["id"] in endpoints for j in partner_jobs)
+                and pair_id not in queued_grades
+            ):
+                control, candidate = partner_jobs
+                queued_grades[pair_id] = grading.submit(
+                    bounded_grade, endpoints[candidate["id"]], endpoints[control["id"]], start
+                )
+            write(
+                STATE / "PROGRESS.json",
+                dict(
+                    admitted=len(admitted),
+                    exported=list(endpoints),
+                    failures=fit_errors,
+                    observed_unix=time.time(),
+                ),
+            )
+        for pair_id, future in queued_grades.items():
+            try:
+                grades[pair_id] = future.result()
+            except Exception as error:
+                grades[pair_id] = dict(error=repr(error))
+    verify_source(ROOT)
+    write(
+        STATE / "COMPLETE.json",
+        dict(
+            stage="bounded_cohort_terminal",
+            elapsed_seconds=time.time() - start,
+            admitted=len(admitted),
+            exported=list(endpoints),
+            failed=fit_errors,
+            rejected_timing=rejected,
+            grades=grades,
+            full_data_fits=0,
+            scientific_fit_attempts=len(admitted),
+            quality_claim="exposed development short-screen only",
+        ),
+        fresh=True,
+    )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("--start-unix", type=float, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--grade", nargs=2)
+    options = parser.parse_args()
+    try:
+        if options.grade:
+            from feature_outputs import grade_pair
+
+            candidate, control = [
+                read(STATE / "work" / name / "EXPORTED.json") for name in options.grade
+            ]
+            check_packet()
+            grade_pair(ROOT, STATE, candidate, control)
+        else:
+            execute(options.start_unix)
+    except Exception as error:
+        write(
+            STATE
+            / (
+                "FAILURE.json"
+                if not options.grade
+                else "GRADE_FAILURE_" + options.grade[0] + ".json"
+            ),
+            dict(error=repr(error), time_unix=time.time()),
+            fresh=True,
+        )
+        raise

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import math
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from recipe import ROOT, STATE, argv_for, legacy, read, sha, write
+
+
+def validate(job: dict) -> dict:
+    """Reject incomplete, unbound, nonfinite or wrong-membership fit endpoints."""
+    work = STATE / "work" / job["id"]
+    output = work / "artifacts/runs" / job["id"]
+    paths = [
+        output / n
+        for n in [
+            "model.pt",
+            "model_ep5.pt",
+            "history.json",
+            "provenance.json",
+            "training_state.pt",
+        ]
+    ]
+    if any(p.is_symlink() or not p.is_file() for p in paths):
+        raise ValueError("Fit lacks complete owned artifacts")
+    provenance = read(output / "provenance.json")
+    args = provenance["args"]
+    request = read(work / "fit_request.json")
+    if request["train_argv"] != argv_for(job, False):
+        raise ValueError("Fit request differs from frozen argv")
+    subset = read(Path(job["subset"]["path"]))
+    split_path = ROOT / "splits" / f"fold{job['fold']}.json"
+    expected = dict(
+        name=job["id"],
+        seed=job["seed"],
+        hidden=512,
+        layers=1,
+        epochs=6,
+        checkpoint_epoch=5,
+        checkpoint_policy="fixed",
+        precision="fp32",
+        fit_subset_manifest=job["subset"]["path"],
+        fit_subset_experiment_id="TABDATA-SHORT4H-20261022-R1",
+        split_manifest_sha256=sha(split_path),
+        fit_subset_manifest_sha256=job["subset"]["sha256"],
+    )
+    modes = {
+        "group": ("group_age", "none"),
+        "field": ("field_age", "none"),
+        "moments": ("causal_innovations", "newest"),
+        "innovations": ("causal_innovations", "none"),
+    }
+    mode, control = modes[job["arm"]]
+    expected.update(
+        research_features=mode,
+        research_feature_control=control,
+        optim="adamw",
+        lr=0.0001,
+        beta2=0.999,
+        wd=0.01,
+        sched="onecycle",
+        warmup_frac=0.05,
+        batch=8,
+        chunk=2000,
+        loss="wmse",
+        loss_norm="chunk",
+        dropout=0.0,
+        no_eval_during_fit=True,
+        save_training_state=True,
+        deterministic=True,
+        init="",
+        distill="",
+        propensity="",
+        swa_frac=0.0,
+        batch_order="seeded",
+    )
+    for key, value in expected.items():
+        if args.get(key) != value:
+            raise ValueError(f"Provenance differs: {key}")
+    if (
+        provenance["selected_epoch"] != 5
+        or provenance["fit_row_groups"] != subset["selected_groups"]
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("Selected endpoint or fitting membership differs")
+    import json
+
+    history = json.loads((output / "history.json").read_text())
+    expected_batches = (job["subset"]["train"] + job["subset"]["valid"]) // 8
+    for epoch, record in enumerate(history):
+        counters = record["update_diagnostics"]["epoch"]
+        if record["epoch"] != epoch or counters["completed_batches"] != expected_batches:
+            raise ValueError("Unexpected epoch or completed batch count")
+        if (
+            counters["optimizer_completed_updates"] != 10 * expected_batches
+            or counters["amp_skipped_updates"] != 0
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("Wrong update count or skipped updates")
+        if record["update_diagnostics"]["grad_stats"]["nonfinite_steps"] != 0 or not math.isfinite(
+            record["train_seconds"]
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("Nonfinite training state")
+    if len(history) != 6:
+        raise ValueError("Incomplete six-epoch history")
+    import torch
+
+    checkpoint = torch.load(output / "model_ep5.pt", map_location="cpu", weights_only=False)
+    model = checkpoint["model"]
+    if any(
+        t.is_floating_point() and (t.dtype != torch.float32 or not torch.isfinite(t).all())
+        for t in model.values()
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("Non-FP32 or nonfinite model state")
+
+    def inspect_tensors(value: object) -> None:
+        if isinstance(value, torch.Tensor):
+            if value.is_floating_point() and (
+                value.dtype != torch.float32 or not torch.isfinite(value).all()
+            ):
+                raise ValueError("Nonfinite or non-FP32 optimizer/training-state tensor")
+        elif isinstance(value, dict):
+            for item in value.values():
+                inspect_tensors(item)
+        elif isinstance(value, (tuple, list)):
+            for item in value:
+                inspect_tensors(item)
+
+    inspect_tensors(
+        torch.load(output / "training_state.pt", map_location="cpu", weights_only=False)
+    )
+    identity = legacy(ROOT)["checkpoint_identity"].verify_checkpoint_pair(
+        output / "model_ep5.pt",
+        output / "model.pt",
+        expected_epoch=5,
+        expected_input_width=323 if job["mechanism"] == "age" else 291,
+    )
+    for name in ("model_ep5.pt", "model.pt"):
+        if provenance["checkpoint_sha256"][name] != sha(output / name):
+            raise ValueError("Checkpoint differs from original provenance")
+    fit = dict(
+        schema="tabdata-short4h-fit-integrity.v1",
+        job=job,
+        checkpoint_sha256=sha(output / "model_ep5.pt"),
+        request_sha256=sha(work / "fit_request.json"),
+        provenance_sha256=sha(output / "provenance.json"),
+        history_sha256=sha(output / "history.json"),
+        successful_updates=60 * expected_batches,
+        checkpoint_payload_sha256=identity.payload_sha256,
+        training_state_sha256=sha(output / "training_state.pt"),
+        expected_args=expected,
+    )
+    write(work / "FIT.json", fit, fresh=True)
+    return fit

+def _sha(path: Path) -> str:
